title.zh: 卷四十四 志第二十 地理五
title.raw: 卷四十四 志第二十 地理五 Volume 44 Treatises 20: Geography 5

sentences.zh: 志第二十 地理五

translations.literal: Treatise Twenty, Geography Five.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Twenty: Geography, Part Five.

sentences.zh: ○湖廣浙江

translations.literal: ○ Huguang Zhejiang
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Huguang and Zhejiang

sentences.zh: 湖廣《禹貢》荊、揚、樑、豫四州之域。

translations.literal: Huguang, in the Tribute of Yu, was the domain of the Jing, Yang, Liang, and Yu four provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang fell within the Jing, Yang, Liang, and Yu provinces described in the Tribute of Yu.

sentences.zh: 元置湖廣等處行中書省，治武昌路，又分置湖南道宣慰司治天臨路屬焉。

translations.literal: Yuan established the Huguang Branch Secretariat, seat at Wuchang Route; also separately established the Hunan Circuit Pacification Commission, seated at Tianlin Route, subordinate thereto.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan established the Huguang Branch Secretariat at Wuchang Route and also set up the Hunan Circuit Pacification Commission at Tianlin Route under its authority.

sentences.zh: 又以襄陽等三路屬河南江北等處行中書省，又分置荊湖北道宣慰司治中興路並屬焉。

translations.literal: Also made Xiangyang and other three routes belong to the Henan-Jiangbei Branch Secretariat; also separately established the Northern Huguang Circuit Pacification Commission, seated at Zhongxing Route, likewise subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangyang and three other routes were placed under the Henan-Jiangbei Branch Secretariat, while the Northern Huguang Circuit Pacification Commission was seated at Zhongxing Route and also made subordinate.

sentences.zh: 太祖甲辰年二月平陳理，置湖廣等處行中書省。

translations.literal: Taizu jia-chen year second month pacified Chen Li, established the Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the Taizu jia-chen year Chen Li was pacified and the Huguang Branch Secretariat was established.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年十二月置武昌都衛。

translations.literal: Hongwu third year twelfth month established Wuchang Regional Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Hongwu 3 the Wuchang Regional Guard was established.

sentences.zh: 與行中書省同治。

translations.literal: Together with the Branch Secretariat same administration.
translations.idiomatic: It shared the same seat and administration as the branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八年十月改都衛爲湖廣都指揮使司。

translations.literal: Year eight tenth month changed Regional Guard to Huguang Regional Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 8 the regional guard became the Huguang Regional Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 九年六月改行中書省爲承宣布政使司。

translations.literal: Year nine sixth month changed Branch Secretariat to Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 9 the branch secretariat was made a provincial administration commission.

sentences.zh: 領府十五，直隸州二，屬州十七，縣一百有八，宣慰司二，宣撫司四，安撫司五，長官司二十一，蠻夷長官司五。

translations.literal: Governing fifteen prefectures, two directly governed zhou, seventeen subordinate zhou, one hundred eight counties, two pacification commissions, four pacification superintendencies, five soothing commissions, twenty-one native chieftain offices, five barbarian native chieftain offices.
translations.idiomatic: It governed fifteen prefectures, two directly governed zhou, seventeen subordinate zhou, 108 counties, two pacification commissions, four pacification superintendencies, five soothing commissions, twenty-one native chieftain offices, and five barbarian native chieftain offices.

sentences.zh: 爲裏三千四百八十有奇。

translations.literal: As li, three thousand four hundred eighty-odd.
translations.idiomatic: Its registered area was more than 3,480 li square.

sentences.zh: 北至均州，與河南、陝西界。

translations.literal: North to Junzhou, borders Henan, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Northward to Junzhou, on the Henan and Shaanxi frontiers.

sentences.zh: 南至九疑，與廣東、廣西界。

translations.literal: South to Jiuyi, borders Guangdong, Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Southward to Jiuyi, on the Guangdong and Guangxi frontiers.

sentences.zh: 東至蘄州，與江南、江西界。

translations.literal: East to Qizhou, borders Jiangnan, Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Eastward to Qizhou, on the Jiangnan and Jiangxi frontiers.

sentences.zh: 西至施州，與四川、貴州界。

translations.literal: West to Shizhou, borders Sichuan, Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Westward to Shizhou, on the Sichuan and Guizhou frontiers.

sentences.zh: 距南京一千七百一十五里，京師五千一百七十里。

translations.literal: Distance from Nanjing one thousand seven hundred fifteen li, from capital five thousand one hundred seventy li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 1,715 li from Nanjing and 5,170 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十六年編戶七十七萬五千八百五十一，口四百七十萬二千六百六十。

translations.literal: Hongwu twenty-six registered households seven hundred seventy-five thousand eight hundred fifty-one, mouths four million seven hundred two thousand six hundred sixty.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 26 registered households totaled 775,851 and population 4,702,660.

sentences.zh: 弘治四年，戶五十萬四千八百七十，口三百七十八萬一千七百一十四。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year four, households five hundred four thousand eight hundred seventy, mouths three million seven hundred eighty-one thousand seven hundred fourteen.
translations.idiomatic: By Hongzhi 4 there were 504,870 households and 3,781,714 people.

sentences.zh: 萬曆六年，戶五十四萬一千三百一十，口四百三十九萬八千七百八十五。

translations.literal: Wanli year six, households five hundred forty-one thousand three hundred ten, mouths four million three hundred ninety-eight thousand seven hundred eighty-five.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 6 the province had 541,310 households and 4,398,785 people.

sentences.zh: 武昌府元武昌路，屬湖廣行省。

translations.literal: Wuchang Prefecture: Yuan Wuchang Route, belonged to Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Wuchang Prefecture—under the Yuan it was Wuchang Route in the Huguang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 太祖甲辰年二月爲府。

translations.literal: Taizu jia-chen year second month made prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the Taizu jia-chen year it was made a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領州一，縣九：

translations.literal: Governing one zhou, nine counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed one zhou and nine counties:

sentences.zh: 江夏倚。

translations.literal: Jiangxia, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxia (seat-attached county).

sentences.zh: 洪武三年四月建楚王府於城內黃龍山。

translations.literal: Hongwu third year fourth month built Chu princely mansion within city at Huanglong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Hongwu 3 the Chu princely mansion was built within the city on Mt. Huanglong.

sentences.zh: 東有黃鵠山，下爲黃鵠磯，臨大江。

translations.literal: East has Huangwu Mountain, below is Huangwu Jetty, facing Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Mt. Huangwu; below it is Huangwu Jetty on the Great River.

sentences.zh: 又南有金水，一名塗水，西流至金口入江，有金口鎮巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also south has Jin River, one name Tu River, flows west to Jinkou enters river, has Jinkou Town Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Jin River, also called the Tu River, which flows west to Jinkou and enters the river; there is the Jinkou Town Patrol Inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又北有滸黃洲、西南有鮎魚口鎮二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also north has Huhuang Isle, southwest has Nianyu Mouth Town, two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Huhuang Isle and to the southwest Nianyu Mouth Town, where two patrol inspectorates stood.

sentences.zh: 武昌府東。

translations.literal: Wuchang, prefecture east.
translations.idiomatic: Wuchang county lies east of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 西有樊山，一名西山，產銀銅鐵及紫石英。

translations.literal: West has Fan Mountain, one name West Mountain, produces silver, copper, iron, and purple quartz.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Mt. Fan, also called West Mountain, which yields silver, copper, iron, and purple quartz.

sentences.zh: 南有神人山，其下爲白鹿磯。

translations.literal: South has Shenren Mountain, below is Bailu Jetty.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Mt. Shenren; below it is Bailu Jetty.

sentences.zh: 西有西塞山，與大冶縣界。

translations.literal: West has Xisai Mountain, borders Daye County.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Mt. Xisai, on the border with Daye County.

sentences.zh: 北濱江，中有蘆洲，亦曰羅洲。

translations.literal: North borders river, within is Luzhou, also called Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The north lies on the river; midstream is Luzhou, also called Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 又西南有樊港，一名樊溪，又名袁溪，匯縣南湖澤凡九十九，北入大江，曰樊口。

translations.literal: Also southwest has Fangang, one name Fan Creek, also named Yuan Creek, gathers county south lake marshes totaling ninety-nine, north enters Great River, called Fankou.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Fangang, also called Fan Creek and Yuan Creek, which collects ninety-nine south-lake marshes of the county and enters the Great River northward at Fankou.

sentences.zh: 又東有南湖，一名五丈湖，通大江。

translations.literal: Also east has South Lake, one name Wuzhang Lake, connects to Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is South Lake, also called Wuzhang Lake, which connects to the Great River.

sentences.zh: 東有金子磯鎮、又有赤土磯鎮、西南有白湖鎮三巡檢司。

translations.literal: East has Jinzi Jetty Town, also has Chitu Jetty Town, southwest has Baihu Town, three patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the east are the Jinzi Jetty Town and Chitu Jetty Town patrol inspectorates, and to the southwest the Baihu Town Patrol Inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 南有金牛鎮、西有三江口鎮二巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: South has Jinniu Town, west has Sanjiang Mouth Town two patrol inspectorates, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the south was Jinniu Town and to the west Sanjiang Mouth Town—two patrol inspectorates later abolished.

sentences.zh: 嘉魚府西南。

translations.literal: Jiayu, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Jiayu county lies southwest of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 西有赤壁山，與江夏縣界。

translations.literal: West has Chibi Mountain, borders Jiangxia County.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Mt. Chibi, on the border with Jiangxia County.

sentences.zh: 北岸對烏林。

translations.literal: North bank faces Wulin.
translations.idiomatic: On the north bank it faces Wulin.

sentences.zh: 西北濱大江，有陸水流入焉，曰陸口，亦曰蒲圻口。

translations.literal: Northwest borders Great River, has Lu River flows in, called Lukou, also called Puqi Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: The northwest lies on the Great River, where the Lu River flows in at Lukou, also called Puqi Mouth.

sentences.zh: 東北有簰洲鎮、西南有石頭口鎮二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast has Paizhou Town, southwest has Shitou Mouth Town two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Paizhou Town Patrol Inspectorate and to the southwest the Shitou Mouth Town Patrol Inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 蒲圻府西南。

translations.literal: Puqi, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Puqi county lies southwest of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 西有蒲首山。

translations.literal: West has Pushou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Mt. Pushou.

sentences.zh: 南有蒲圻河，即陸水也。

translations.literal: South has Puqi River, namely Lu River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Puqi River, which is the Lu River.

sentences.zh: 又西有蒲圻湖。

translations.literal: Also west has Puqi Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is Puqi Lake.

sentences.zh: 西南有新店等湖，下流至嘉魚縣之石頭口，注於大江。

translations.literal: Southwest has Xindian and other lakes, lower flow to Jiayu County's Shitou Mouth, pours into Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest are Xindian and other lakes whose lower course reaches Shitou Mouth in Jiayu County and pours into the Great River.

sentences.zh: 西南有羊樓巡檢司。

translations.literal: Southwest has Yanglou Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Yanglou Patrol Inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 咸寧府東南。

translations.literal: Xianning, prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Xianning county lies southeast of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 陳友諒時徙治河北。

translations.literal: Chen Youliang's time moved seat north of river.
translations.idiomatic: Under Chen Youliang the seat was moved north of the river.

sentences.zh: 洪武中復還故城，即今治也。

translations.literal: Hongwu period restored to former city, namely present seat.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongwu period it was restored to the former city, which is the present seat.

sentences.zh: 西有淦水，即金水之別名。

translations.literal: West has Gan River, namely Jin River's other name.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Gan River, another name for the Jin River.

sentences.zh: 崇陽府南。

translations.literal: Chongyang, prefecture south.
translations.idiomatic: Chongyang county lies south of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 西有巖頭山。

translations.literal: West has Yantou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Mt. Yantou.

sentences.zh: 西南有龍泉山。

translations.literal: Southwest has Longquan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Mt. Longquan.

sentences.zh: 東北有壺頭山，下有壺頭港，亦曰崇陽港，匯羣川西合陸水，又名雋水。

translations.literal: Northeast has Hutou Mountain, below has Hutou Port, also called Chongyang Port, gathers western streams together joining Lu River, also named Juan River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Mt. Hutou; below it is Hutou Port, also called Chongyang Port, where western streams gather and join the Lu River—also called the Juan River.

sentences.zh: 通城府西南。

translations.literal: Tongcheng, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Tongcheng county lies southwest of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 南有錫山，舊產銀錫。

translations.literal: South has Xi Mountain, formerly produced silver and tin.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Mt. Xi, which formerly yielded silver and tin.

sentences.zh: 北有陸水，自巴陵縣流入。

translations.literal: North has Lu River, from Baling County flows in.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Lu River, which flows in from Baling County.

sentences.zh: 興國州元興國路，屬湖廣行省。

translations.literal: Xingguo zhou: Yuan Xingguo Route, belonged to Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Xingguo zhou—under the Yuan it was Xingguo Route in the Huguang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 太祖甲辰年二月爲府。

translations.literal: Taizu jia-chen year second month made prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the Taizu jia-chen year it was made a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武九年四月降爲州，以州治永興縣省入，來屬。

translations.literal: Hongwu ninth year fourth month reduced to zhou, with zhou seat Yongxing County abolished and merged in, came to belong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Hongwu 9 it was reduced to a zhou, Yongxing County as the zhou seat was abolished and merged in, and it was placed under the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 北有銀山，西有黃姑山，舊俱產銀。

translations.literal: North has Yin Mountain, west has Huanggu Mountain, both formerly produced silver.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Mt. Yin and to the west Mt. Huanggu—both formerly yielded silver.

sentences.zh: 南有太平山，與九宮山接。

translations.literal: South has Taiping Mountain, connects with Jiugong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Mt. Taiping, which joins Mt. Jiugong.

sentences.zh: 東有大坡山，產茶。

translations.literal: East has Dapo Mountain, produces tea.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Mt. Dapo, which produces tea.

sentences.zh: 東北有大江。

translations.literal: Northeast has Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Great River.

sentences.zh: 東有富池湖，亦曰富水，北流注於江，有富池鎮巡檢司。

translations.literal: East has Fuchi Lake, also called Fu River, flows north pours into river, has Fuchi Town Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Fuchi Lake, also called the Fu River, which flows north into the river; there is the Fuchi Town Patrol Inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又東北有黃顙口鎮巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also northeast has Huangxiang Mouth Town Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northeast is the Huangxiang Mouth Town Patrol Inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 西北距府三百八十里。

translations.literal: Northwest distance from prefecture three hundred eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 380 li northwest of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 領縣二：

translations.literal: Governing two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed two counties:

sentences.zh: 大冶州西北。

translations.literal: Daye, zhou northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Daye county lies northwest of the zhou seat.

sentences.zh: 北有鐵山，又有白雉山，出銅礦。

translations.literal: North has Tieshan, also has Baizhi Mountain, yields copper ore.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Mt. Tieshan and also Mt. Baizhi, which yield copper ore.

sentences.zh: 又東有圍爐山，出鐵。

translations.literal: Also east has Weilu Mountain, yields iron.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Mt. Weilu, which yields iron.

sentences.zh: 又西南有銅綠山，舊產銅。

translations.literal: Also southwest has Tonglu Mountain, formerly produced copper.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Mt. Tonglu, which formerly yielded copper.

sentences.zh: 大江在北。

translations.literal: Great River in north.
translations.idiomatic: The Great River lies to the north.

sentences.zh: 有道士洑巡檢司。

translations.literal: Has Daoshi Ford Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: There is the Daoshi Ford Patrol Inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 通山州西少南。

translations.literal: Tongshan, zhou west slightly south.
translations.idiomatic: Tongshan county lies slightly southwest of the zhou seat.

sentences.zh: 東南有九宮山，寶石河出焉，下流合於富水。

translations.literal: Southeast has Jiugong Mountain, Baoshi River issues there, lower flow joins Fu River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Mt. Jiugong, where the Baoshi River rises and below joins the Fu River.

sentences.zh: 東有黃泥壠巡檢司。

translations.literal: East has Huangnilong Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Huangnilong Patrol Inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 漢陽府元屬湖廣行省。

translations.literal: Hanyang Prefecture: Yuan belonged to Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Hanyang Prefecture—under the Yuan it belonged to the Huguang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 洪武九年四月降爲州，屬武昌府。

translations.literal: Hongwu ninth year fourth month reduced to zhou, belonged to Wuchang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Hongwu 9 it was reduced to a zhou subordinate to Wuchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月復爲府。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year fifth month again made prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 13 it was again made a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 屬湖廣佈政司，尋屬河南。

translations.literal: Belonged to Huguang Provincial Administration Commission, soon belonged to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: It belonged to the Huguang provincial administration commission, then soon to Henan.

sentences.zh: 二十四年六月還湖廣。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year sixth month returned to Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 24 it was returned to Huguang.

sentences.zh: 領縣二。

translations.literal: Governing two counties.
translations.idiomatic: It governed two counties.

sentences.zh: 西北距布政司，隔江僅七里。

translations.literal: Northwest distance from provincial administration commission, across river only seven li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay only seven li northwest of the provincial administration commission seat, across the river.

sentences.zh: 漢陽倚。

translations.literal: Hanyang, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Hanyang (seat-attached county).

sentences.zh: 洪武九年四月省。

translations.literal: Hongwu ninth year fourth month abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Hongwu 9 it was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月復置。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year fifth month again established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 13 it was restored.

sentences.zh: 大別山在城東北，一名翼際山，又名魯山。

translations.literal: Mt. Dabie in city northeast, one name Yiji Mountain, also named Lu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Mt. Dabie stands northeast of the city, also called Mt. Yiji and Lu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 漢水自漢川縣流入，舊逕山南襄河口入江。

translations.literal: Han River from Hanchuan County flows in, formerly directly passed south of mountain Xianghe Mouth enters river.
translations.idiomatic: The Han River flows in from Hanchuan County and formerly passed south of the mountain to enter the river at Xianghe Mouth.

sentences.zh: 成化初，於縣西郭師口之上決，而東從山北注於大江，即今之漢口也，有漢口巡檢司。

translations.literal: Chenghua beginning, above county west Guoshi Mouth burst, and east from mountain north pours into Great River, namely present Hankou, has Hankou Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Chenghua reign the river burst above Guoshi Mouth west of the county and flowed east along the north of the mountain into the Great River—present-day Hankou—with the Hankou Patrol Inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 大江自巴陵縣西北接洞庭之水，流入府境，至此與漢水會。

translations.literal: Great River from Baling County northwest receives Dongting waters, flows into prefecture territory, here meets Han River.
translations.idiomatic: The Great River, receiving Dongting waters northwest of Baling County, enters the prefectural territory and here meets the Han River.

sentences.zh: 又西南有沔水，即漢水支流也，仍合漢入江。

translations.literal: Also southwest has Mian River, namely Han River branch stream, still joins Han enters river.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Mian River, a branch of the Han that rejoins the Han before entering the river.

sentences.zh: 又有沌水，大江支流也，自沔陽州流入，仍入大江，謂之沌口，有沌口巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also has Dun River, Great River branch stream, from Mianyang zhou flows in, still enters Great River, called Dunkou, has Dunkou Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Dun River, a branch of the Great River that flows in from Mianyang zhou and re-enters the Great River at Dunkou, where the Dunkou Patrol Inspectorate stands.

sentences.zh: 又有弇水，在大江南岸，至弇口入江。

translations.literal: Also has Yan River, on Great River south bank, to Yan Mouth enters river.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Yan River on the south bank of the Great River, which enters the river at Yan Mouth.

sentences.zh: 又北有灄水，亦漢水支流也，有淪水流合焉，下流注於大江。
