sentences.zh: 應山州東。

translations.literal: Lay east of Yingshan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It lay east of Yingshan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武初省。

translations.literal: Abolished at beginning of Hongwu.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished at the beginning of the Hongwu reign.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月復置。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year fifth month restored.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in the fifth month of Hongwu 13.

sentences.zh: 西有雞頭山，澴水出焉。

translations.literal: West has Jitou Mountain, Huan River emerges there.
translations.idiomatic: To the west was Jitou Mountain, where the Huan River rises.

sentences.zh: 西南有溳水。

translations.literal: Southwest has Yun River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest was the Yun River.

sentences.zh: 東有白泉河，與澴水合，入孝感縣界。

translations.literal: East has Baiquan River, joins with Huan River, enters Xiaogan County border.
translations.idiomatic: To the east was the Baiquan River, which joined the Huan and entered the border of Xiaogan County.

sentences.zh: 西北有杏遮關巡檢司，即平靖關，義陽三關之一。

translations.literal: Northwest has Xingzhe Pass patrol inspectorate, namely Pingjing Pass, one of Yiyang three passes.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest was the Xingzhe Pass patrol inspectorate, also called Pingjing Pass—one of the three passes of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 又西南有平裏市巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also southwest has Pingli Market patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest was the Pingli Market patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又東北有武陽關，一名武勝關，又名禮山關，亦義陽三關之一。

translations.literal: Also northeast has Wuyang Pass, one name Wusheng Pass, also named Lishan Pass, also one of Yiyang three passes.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northeast was Wuyang Pass, also called Wusheng Pass and Lishan Pass—again one of the three passes of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 岳州府元岳州路，屬湖廣行省。

translations.literal: Yuezhou Prefecture Yuan Yuezhou Route, belonged to Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Yuezhou Prefecture was the Yuan Yuezhou Route, subordinate to the Huguang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 太祖甲辰年爲府。

translations.literal: Taizu jiachen year became prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the jiachen year of Taizu (1364) it became a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武九年四月降爲州，直隸布政司。

translations.literal: Hongwu ninth year fourth month reduced to subprefecture, directly subordinate to Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Hongwu 9 it was reduced to a subprefecture directly under the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月復爲府。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year first month again became prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Hongwu 14 it was made a prefecture again.

sentences.zh: 領州一，縣七。

translations.literal: Administered one subprefecture, seven counties.
translations.idiomatic: It administered one subprefecture and seven counties.

sentences.zh: 東北距布政司五百里。

translations.literal: Northeast distance to Provincial Administration Commission five hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay five hundred li northeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 巴陵倚。

translations.literal: Baling attached.
translations.idiomatic: Baling (seat-attached county).

sentences.zh: 洪武九年四月省，十四年復置。

translations.literal: Hongwu ninth year fourth month abolished, fourteenth year restored.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in the fourth month of Hongwu 9 and restored in Hongwu 14.

sentences.zh: 西南有巴丘山。

translations.literal: Southwest has Baqiu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest was Baqiu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 又有君山，在洞庭湖中。

translations.literal: Also has Jun Mountain, in Dongting Lake.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Jun Mountain, in Dongting Lake.

sentences.zh: 大江在西北。

translations.literal: Great River in northwest.
translations.idiomatic: The Great River (Yangtze) was to the northwest.

sentences.zh: 洞庭湖上納湘、澧二水，自西南來合，謂之三江口。

translations.literal: Dongting Lake above receives Xiang and Li two rivers, from southwest come and merge, called Sanjiangkou.
translations.idiomatic: Dongting Lake received the Xiang and Li rivers; where they joined from the southwest was called Sanjiangkou (Three-Rivers Mouth).

sentences.zh: 湖之南有青草湖，又西曰赤沙湖，謂之三湖。

translations.literal: South of lake has Qingcao Lake, also west called Chisha Lake, called Three Lakes.
translations.idiomatic: South of the lake was Qingcao Lake; farther west was Chisha Lake—these were called the Three Lakes.

sentences.zh: 沅、漸、元、辰、敘、酉、澧、澬、湘九水，皆匯於此，故亦名九江。

translations.literal: Yuan, Jian, Yuan, Chen, Xu, You, Li, Zi, Xiang nine waters, all converge here, therefore also named Jiujiang.
translations.idiomatic: The nine rivers Yuan, Jian, Yuan, Chen, Xu, You, Li, Zi, and Xiang all gathered here, so the place was also called Jiujiang (Nine Rivers).

sentences.zh: 東南有氵邕湖，亦名翁湖。

translations.literal: Southeast has Yong Lake, also named Weng Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast was Yong Lake, also called Weng Lake.

sentences.zh: 南有鹿角巡檢司。

translations.literal: South has Lujiao patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the south was the Lujiao patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 臨湘府東北。

translations.literal: Linxiang prefecture northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Linxiang County lay northeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 東南有龍窖山，跨臨湘、通城、當陽、蒲圻四縣界。

translations.literal: Southeast has Longjiao Mountain, spans Linxiang, Tongcheng, Dangyang, Puqi four counties border.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast was Longjiao Mountain, straddling the borders of Linxiang, Tongcheng, Dangyang, and Puqi counties.

sentences.zh: 西南有城陵磯，又有道人磯，皆濱大江，有城陵磯巡檢司。

translations.literal: Southwest has Chenglingji, also has Daorenji, all border Great River, has Chenglingji patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest were Chenglingji and Daorenji, both on the Great River; there was a Chenglingji patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又南有土門鎮、東北有鴨欄磯二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also south has Tumen Town, northeast has Yalanji two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south was the Tumen Town patrol inspectorate; to the northeast was the Yalanji patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 華容府西北。

translations.literal: Huarong prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Huarong County lay northwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 東有東山，又有石門山。

translations.literal: East has East Mountain, also has Shimen Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east were East Mountain and Shimen Mountain.

sentences.zh: 大江在北。

translations.literal: Great River in north.
translations.idiomatic: The Great River was to the north.

sentences.zh: 又有華容河，自大江分流，南達洞庭湖。

translations.literal: Also has Huarong River, from Great River diverges, south reaches Dongting Lake.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the Huarong River, branching from the Great River and reaching Dongting Lake to the south.

sentences.zh: 南有澧水，東流入洞庭湖。

translations.literal: South has Li River, east flows into Dongting Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the south was the Li River, which flowed east into Dongting Lake.

sentences.zh: 西南有赤沙湖，與洞庭湖接。

translations.literal: Southwest has Chisha Lake, connects with Dongting Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest was Chisha Lake, adjoining Dongting Lake.

sentences.zh: 南有明山古樓巡檢司。

translations.literal: South has Mingshan Gulu patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the south was the Mingshan Gulu patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又東北有黃家穴巡檢司，後移於塔市。

translations.literal: Also northeast has Huangjiaxue patrol inspectorate, later moved to Tashi.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northeast was the Huangjiaxue patrol inspectorate, later moved to Tashi.

sentences.zh: 北有北河渡巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: North has Beihedu patrol inspectorate, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the north was the Beihedu patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 平江府東南。

translations.literal: Pingjiang prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Pingjiang County lay southeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元平江州，洪武三年降爲縣。

translations.literal: Yuan Pingjiang Subprefecture, Hongwu third year reduced to county.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuan it was Pingjiang Subprefecture; in Hongwu 3 it was reduced to a county.

sentences.zh: 北有永寧山。

translations.literal: North has Yongning Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north was Yongning Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東北有幕阜山。

translations.literal: Northeast has Mufu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast was Mufu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東有汨水，西南流，昌水北流入焉。

translations.literal: East has Mi River, flows southwest, Chang River north flows in.
translations.idiomatic: To the east was the Mi River, flowing southwest; the Chang River entered from the north.

sentences.zh: 東北有長壽巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast has Changshou patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast was the Changshou patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 澧州元澧州路，屬湖廣行省。

translations.literal: Lizhou Yuan Lizhou Route, belonged to Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Lizhou was the Yuan Lizhou Route, subordinate to the Huguang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 太祖甲辰年爲府。

translations.literal: Taizu jiachen year became prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the jiachen year of Taizu (1364) it became a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九年四月降爲州，以州治澧陽縣省入，屬常德府。

translations.literal: Ninth year fourth month reduced to subprefecture, by subprefecture seat Liyang County abolished merged in, belonged to Changde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Hongwu 9 it was reduced to a subprefecture; Liyang County, the seat, was abolished and merged in, and it was placed under Changde Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三十年三月來屬。

translations.literal: Thirtieth year third month came subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Hongwu 30 it was reassigned here.

sentences.zh: 元元貞末徙治新城。

translations.literal: Yuan Yuanzhen end moved seat to New City.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Yuanzhen reign (Yuan) the seat was moved to New City.

sentences.zh: 洪武五年復舊治。

translations.literal: Hongwu fifth year restored old seat.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 5 the former seat was restored.

sentences.zh: 東有關山。

translations.literal: East has Guan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east was Guan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西南有大浮山，跨石門、武陵、桃源三縣界。

translations.literal: Southwest has Dafu Mountain, spans Shimen, Wuling, Taoyuan three counties border.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest was Dafu Mountain, straddling Shimen, Wuling, and Taoyuan counties.

sentences.zh: 南有澧水，一名蘭江，亦曰繡水。

translations.literal: South has Li River, one name Lan River, also called Xiushui.
translations.idiomatic: To the south was the Li River, also called the Lan River and the Xiushui.

sentences.zh: 其東有澹水，北有涔水，俱流入焉。

translations.literal: Its east has Tan River, north has Cen River, all flow in.
translations.idiomatic: To its east was the Tan River and to the north the Cen River—both flowed into it.

sentences.zh: 東有嘉山鎮巡檢司。

translations.literal: East has Jiashan Town patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the east was the Jiashan Town patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 東距府二百七十里。

translations.literal: East distance to prefecture two hundred seventy li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay two hundred seventy li east of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領縣三：

translations.literal: Administered three counties:
translations.idiomatic: It administered three counties:

sentences.zh: 安鄉州東南。

translations.literal: Anxiang subprefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Anxiang County lay southeast of the subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 西有澧水，一名長河。

translations.literal: West has Li River, one name Chang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west was the Li River, also called the Chang River.

sentences.zh: 北有涔水。

translations.literal: North has Cen River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north was the Cen River.

sentences.zh: 石門州西。

translations.literal: Shimen subprefecture west.
translations.idiomatic: Shimen County lay west of the subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 南有澧水。

translations.literal: South has Li River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south was the Li River.

sentences.zh: 西北有渫水，亦名添平河，自添平所南流入焉。

translations.literal: Northwest has Xie River, also named Tianping River, from Tianping guard post south flows in.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest was the Xie River, also called the Tianping River, which entered from the south at the Tianping guard post.

sentences.zh: 慈利州西少南。

translations.literal: Cili subprefecture west slightly south.
translations.idiomatic: Cili County lay slightly southwest of the subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 元慈利州，洪武二年降爲縣。

translations.literal: Yuan Cili Subprefecture, Hongwu second year reduced to county.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuan it was Cili Subprefecture; in Hongwu 2 it was reduced to a county.

sentences.zh: 西南有天門山，有檳榔洞，與瑤分界。

translations.literal: Southwest has Tianmen Mountain, has Binglang Cave, divides border with Yao.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest was Tianmen Mountain, with Binglang Cave marking the border with the Yao.

sentences.zh: 又西有崇山。

translations.literal: Also west has Chong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west was Chong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 又有歷山，澧水出焉，下流至華容縣入於洞庭湖。

translations.literal: Also has Li Mountain, Li River emerges there, lower stream to Huarong County enters Dongting Lake.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Li Mountain, where the Li River rises; below it reached Huarong County and entered Dongting Lake.

sentences.zh: 又西有漊水，源出四川巫山縣，東流合諸溪澗之水，至縣西匯於澧水，亦曰後江。

translations.literal: Also west has Lou River, source emerges from Sichuan Wushan County, east flows merging various streams and brooks, to county west converges at Li River, also called Hou River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west was the Lou River, rising in Wushan County, Sichuan; flowing east it gathered tributary streams and at the west of the county joined the Li, also called the Hou River.

sentences.zh: 西南有永定衛，洪武中置，二十三年八月徙於永順宣慰司之芋岸坪。

translations.literal: Southwest has Yongding Guard, established in Hongwu, twenty-third year eighth month moved to Yuping of Yongshun Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest was Yongding Guard, established in the Hongwu period; in the eighth month of Hongwu 23 it was moved to Yuping in the Yongshun Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 西北有龍伏關，東南有後平關、黑崇關，謂之永定三關。

translations.literal: Northwest has Longfu Pass, southeast has Houping Pass and Heichong Pass, called Yongding three passes.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest was Longfu Pass; to the southeast were Houping Pass and Heichong Pass—these were called the three passes of Yongding.

sentences.zh: 所屬曰大庸守禦千戶所，本大庸衛，在衛西，洪武九年四月置，三十一年改爲所，曰茅岡長官司，在衛東北，正統中永定衛置。

translations.literal: Subordinate: Dayong defense thousand-household post, originally Dayong Guard, west of guard, Hongwu ninth year fourth month established, thirty-first year changed to post; Maogang Chief Office, northeast of guard, established when Yongding Guard set up in Zhengtong.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate to it were: the Dayong defense thousand-household post (originally Dayong Guard, west of the guard; established in the fourth month of Hongwu 9, converted to a post in Hongwu 31); and the Maogang Chief Office northeast of the guard, established when Yongding Guard was set up in the Zhengtong reign.

sentences.zh: 北有九溪衛，洪武二十三年六月置，有九淵、野牛、三江口、閘口四關。

translations.literal: North has Jiuxi Guard, Hongwu twenty-third year sixth month established, has Jiuyuan, Yeniu, Sanjiangkou, Zhakou four passes.
translations.idiomatic: To the north was Jiuxi Guard, established in the sixth month of Hongwu 23, with the four passes Jiuyuan, Yeniu, Sanjiangkou, and Zhakou.

sentences.zh: 所屬曰守禦添平千戶所，在衛北，洪武二年置。

translations.literal: Subordinate: Tianping defense thousand-household post, north of guard, Hongwu second year established.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate to it was the Tianping defense thousand-household post, north of the guard, established in Hongwu 2.

sentences.zh: 曰守禦安福千戶所，在衛西北，洪武二十三年九月置。

translations.literal: Anfu defense thousand-household post, northwest of guard, Hongwu twenty-third year ninth month established.
translations.idiomatic: Also the Anfu defense thousand-household post northwest of the guard, established in the ninth month of Hongwu 23.

sentences.zh: 曰守禦麻寮千戶所，在衛北，洪武四年置。

translations.literal: Maliao defense thousand-household post, north of guard, Hongwu fourth year established.
translations.idiomatic: Also the Maliao defense thousand-household post north of the guard, established in Hongwu 4.

sentences.zh: 曰桑植安撫司，本桑植、荒溪等處宣撫司，在衛西北，太祖丙午年二月置，後廢，永樂四年十一月改置。

translations.literal: Sangzhi Pacification Commission, originally Sangzhi, Huangxi and other pacification commissions, northwest of guard, Taizu bingwu year second month established, later abolished, Yongle fourth year eleventh month re-established.
translations.idiomatic: Also the Sangzhi Pacification Commission (originally the Sangzhi, Huangxi, and other pacification commissions), northwest of the guard; established in the second month of Taizu's bingwu year (1366), later abolished, and re-established in the eleventh month of Yongle 4.

sentences.zh: 荊州府元中興路，屬荊湖北道。

translations.literal: Jingzhou Prefecture Yuan Zhongxing Route, belonged to Jinghu North Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou Prefecture was the Yuan Zhongxing Route, subordinate to the Jinghu North Circuit.

sentences.zh: 太祖甲辰年九月改爲荊州府，屬湖廣行省。

translations.literal: Taizu jiachen year ninth month changed to Jingzhou Prefecture, belonged to Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the jiachen year of Taizu (1364) it was renamed Jingzhou Prefecture, subordinate to the Huguang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 吳元年十月置湖廣分省於此，尋罷。

translations.literal: Wu first year tenth month established Huguang sub-province here, soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Wu (1365) a Huguang sub-province was established here but was soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 九年屬湖廣佈政司，尋改屬河南。

translations.literal: Ninth year belonged to Huguang Provincial Administration Commission, soon changed subordinate to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 9 it came under the Huguang Provincial Administration Commission, then was reassigned to Henan.

sentences.zh: 二十四年還屬。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year returned subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 24 it was returned to Huguang.

sentences.zh: 領州二，縣十一。

translations.literal: Administered two subprefectures, eleven counties.
translations.idiomatic: It administered two subprefectures and eleven counties.

sentences.zh: 東距布政司千二百一十里。

translations.literal: East distance to Provincial Administration Commission one thousand two hundred ten li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one thousand two hundred ten li east of the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 江陵倚。

translations.literal: Jiangling attached.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangling (seat-attached county).

sentences.zh: 洪武十一年正月建湘王府，建文元年四月除。

translations.literal: Hongwu eleventh year first month built Xiang Princely Establishment, Jianwen first year fourth month abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Hongwu 11 the Xiang princely establishment was built; it was abolished in the fourth month of Jianwen 1.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年，遼王府自遼東廣寧遷於此，隆慶二年十月除。

translations.literal: Yongle first year, Liao Princely Establishment from Liaodong Guangning moved here, Longqing second year tenth month abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 1 the Liao princely establishment was moved here from Guangning in Liaodong; it was abolished in the tenth month of Longqing 2.

sentences.zh: 萬曆二十九年十月建惠王府。

translations.literal: Wanli twenty-ninth year tenth month built Hui Princely Establishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Wanli 29 the Hui princely establishment was built.

sentences.zh: 南濱江。

translations.literal: South borders river.
translations.idiomatic: It bordered the river on the south.

sentences.zh: 東南有夏水，至沔陽州合於沔水，故沔水亦兼夏水之名。

translations.literal: Southeast has Xia River, to Mianyang Subprefecture merges with Mian River, therefore Mian River also shares Xia River name.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast was the Xia River, which joined the Mian at Mianyang Subprefecture, so the Mian was also known by the name of the Xia.

sentences.zh: 又有陽水，東北至景陵縣，入沔水。

translations.literal: Also has Yang River, northeast to Jingling County, enters Mian River.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the Yang River, flowing northeast to Jingling County and entering the Mian.

sentences.zh: 又東北有三海，沮、漳水匯流處。

translations.literal: Also northeast has Sanhai, place where Ju and Zhang rivers converge.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northeast was Sanhai, where the Ju and Zhang rivers met.

sentences.zh: 北有柞溪。

translations.literal: North has Zuo Stream.
translations.idiomatic: To the north was Zuo Stream.

sentences.zh: 又東有靈溪，亦曰零水，南入江，謂之零口。

translations.literal: Also east has Ling Stream, also called Ling River, south enters river, called Lingkou.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east was Ling Stream, also called Ling River; where it entered the river to the south was called Lingkou.

sentences.zh: 東北有龍彎市、東南有沙頭市、南有郝穴口、西南有虎渡口四巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast has Longwan Market, southeast Shatou Market, south Haohekou, southwest Hudukou four patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast was the Longwan Market patrol inspectorate; to the southeast, Shatou Market; to the south, Haohekou; and to the southwest, Hudukou.

sentences.zh: 公安府東南。

translations.literal: Gong'an prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Gong'an County lay southeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 東北有舊城。

translations.literal: Northeast has old walled city.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast was the old walled city.

sentences.zh: 今治崇禎元年所遷。

translations.literal: Present seat moved in Chongzhen first year.
translations.idiomatic: The present seat was moved in the first year of Chongzhen.

sentences.zh: 北濱江，西北有油河流入焉，謂之油口，有油口巡檢司。

translations.literal: North borders river, northwest has You River flows in, called Youkou, has Youkou patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: It bordered the river on the north; from the northwest the You River entered, at a place called Youkou, where there was a Youkou patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 東北有夏水。

translations.literal: Northeast has Xia water.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Xia River.

sentences.zh: 石首府東南。

translations.literal: Shishou, prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Shishou lies southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 元末治楚望山北，洪武中徙繡林山左，本宋時舊治也。

translations.literal: End of Yuan seat at north of Chuwang Mountain; Hongwu period moved to left of Xiulin Mountain; originally Song-period old seat.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Yuan the seat lay north of Chuwang Mountain; in the Hongwu period it was moved to the left of Xiulin Mountain—the old seat of Song times.

sentences.zh: 北濱江，江中有石首山。

translations.literal: North borders river; in river is Shishou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north it borders the river; in the river is Shishou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 又東有焦山，下有港，通洞庭湖。

translations.literal: Also east has Jiao Mountain, below is harbor, connects to Dongting Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is also Jiao Mountain, with a harbor below that connects to Dongting Lake.

sentences.zh: 有調絃口巡檢司。

translations.literal: Has Tiaoxiankou patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: There is the Tiaoxiankou patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 監利府東少南。

translations.literal: Jianli, prefecture east slightly south.
translations.idiomatic: Jianli lies east and slightly south of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 南濱江。

translations.literal: South borders river.
translations.idiomatic: To the south it borders the river.

sentences.zh: 東南有魯洑江，亦曰夏水，自大江分流，下至沔陽州入沔。

translations.literal: Southeast has Lufu River, also called Xia water, branches from Great River, below reaches Mianyang zhou and enters Mian.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Lufu River, also called the Xia River, which branches from the Great River and below reaches Mianyang zhou before entering the Mian.

sentences.zh: 又西有涌水，南入江，謂之涌口。

translations.literal: Also west has Yong water, south enters river, called Yongkou.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is also the Yong River, which flows south into the river at what is called Yongkou.

sentences.zh: 又東有瓦子灣、西有窯所、南有白螺磯、北有毛家口、又有分鹽所五巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also east has Waziwan, west has Yaosuo, south has Bailuoji, north has Maojiakou, also has Fenyansuo five patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is also Waziwan; to the west Yaosuo; to the south Bailuoji; to the north Maojiakou; and there is also the Fenyansuo patrol inspectorate—five in all.

sentences.zh: 鬆滋府西南。

translations.literal: Songzi, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Songzi lies southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 西南有巴山。

translations.literal: Southwest has Ba Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Ba Mountain.

sentences.zh: 北濱大江。

translations.literal: North borders Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north it borders the Great River.

sentences.zh: 南有紅崖子巡檢司。

translations.literal: South has Hongyazi patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Hongyazi patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又有西坪塞巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: Also has Xiping Stockade patrol inspectorate, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the Xiping Stockade patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 枝江府西。

translations.literal: Zhijiang, prefecture west.
translations.idiomatic: Zhijiang lies west of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 洪武十年五月省入鬆滋縣。

translations.literal: Hongwu tenth year fifth month reduced and merged into Songzi County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was reduced and merged into Songzi County.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月復置。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year fifth month again established.
translations.idiomatic: It was re-established in the fifth month of year 13.

sentences.zh: 北濱大江，江中有百里洲，江水經此而分，故曰枝江。

translations.literal: North borders Great River; in river is Baili Isle, Great River passes here and divides, hence called Zhijiang.
translations.idiomatic: To the north it borders the Great River; in the river is Baili Isle, where the Great River passes and divides—hence the name Zhijiang.

sentences.zh: 北有沮水，南入江，謂之沮口。

translations.literal: North has Ju River, south enters river, called Jukou.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Ju River, which flows south into the river at what is called Jukou.

sentences.zh: 夷陵州元峽州路，屬荊湖北道宣慰司。

translations.literal: Yiling zhou Yuan Xia zhou Route, belonged to Jinghu North Circuit Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Yiling zhou was the Yuan Xia zhou Route, subordinate to the Jinghu North Circuit Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 太祖甲辰年爲府。

translations.literal: Taizu Jiachen year became fu.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taizu Jiachen year it became a fu.

sentences.zh: 九月降爲州，直隸湖廣行省。

translations.literal: Ninth month demoted to zhou, directly subordinate Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month it was demoted to a zhou, directly subordinate to the Huguang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 九年四月改州名夷陵，以州治夷陵縣省入，來屬。

translations.literal: Ninth year fourth month changed zhou name to Yiling, with seat county Yiling abolished and merged in, came subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 9 its name was changed to Yiling, the seat county Yiling was abolished and merged in, and it was placed subordinate here.

sentences.zh: 大江在南。

translations.literal: Great River at south.
translations.idiomatic: The Great River is to the south.

sentences.zh: 西北有關曰下牢關，夾江爲險。

translations.literal: Northwest has pass called Xialao Pass, flanking river as danger.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is a pass called Xialao Pass, flanking the river as a strategic hazard.

sentences.zh: 又有西陵、明月、黃牛三峽，峽中有使君、虎頭、狼尾、鹿角等灘，皆江流至險處也。

translations.literal: Also has Xiling, Mingyue, Huangniu Three Gorges; within gorges are Shijun, Hutou, Langwei, Lujiao and other shoals—all places where the river current is most perilous.
translations.idiomatic: There are also the Xiling, Mingyue, and Huangniu Three Gorges; within the gorges are the Shijun, Hutou, Langwei, Lujiao, and other shoals—all where the river current is most perilous.

sentences.zh: 西北有赤谿，東合大江。

translations.literal: Northwest has Chixi, east joins Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Chixi, which joins the Great River from the east.

sentences.zh: 南有南津口巡檢司。

translations.literal: South has Nanjinkou patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Nanjinkou patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又東有金竹坪巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: Also east has Jinzhuping patrol inspectorate, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the east was also the Jinzhuping patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 又西有西津關。

translations.literal: Also west has Xijin Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is also Xijin Pass.

sentences.zh: 東北有白虎關。

translations.literal: Northeast has Baihu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Baihu Pass.

sentences.zh: 東距府三百四十里。

translations.literal: East distance from fu three hundred forty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay three hundred forty li east of the fu.

sentences.zh: 領縣三：

translations.literal: Administers three counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed three counties:

sentences.zh: 長陽州西南。

translations.literal: Changyang, zhou southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Changyang lies southwest of the zhou.

sentences.zh: 東南有清江。

translations.literal: Southeast has Qing River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Qing River.

sentences.zh: 西有舊關堡、西南有蹇家園、南有漁洋關三巡檢司。

translations.literal: West has Jiuguan Stockade, southwest has Jianjiayuan, south has Yuyang Pass three patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Jiuguan Stockade; to the southwest Jianjiayuan; and to the south Yuyang Pass—three patrol inspectorates.

sentences.zh: 南有古捍關。

translations.literal: South has Guhan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Guhan Pass.

sentences.zh: 西有梅子八關。

translations.literal: West has Meizi Eight Passes.
translations.idiomatic: To the west are the Meizi Eight Passes.

sentences.zh: 宜都州東南。

translations.literal: Yidu, zhou southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Yidu lies southeast of the zhou.

sentences.zh: 西北有荊門山，下臨大江，其對岸即虎牙山也。

translations.literal: Northwest has Jingmen Mountain, below faces Great River; opposite bank is Huya Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Jingmen Mountain, facing the Great River below; on the opposite bank is Huya Mountain.

sentences.zh: 又西有清江，東流合大江，有清江口巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also west has Qing River, east flows joins Great River, has Qingjiangkou patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is also the Qing River, which flows east to join the Great River; there is the Qingjiangkou patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又西北有古江關、東北有普通鎮二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also northwest has Gujiang Pass, northeast has Putong Town two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is also Gujiang Pass, and to the northeast Putong Town—two patrol inspectorates.

sentences.zh: 遠安州東北。

translations.literal: Yuan'an, zhou northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan'an lies northeast of the zhou.

sentences.zh: 舊治亭子山下。

translations.literal: Old seat below Tingzi Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The old seat lay below Tingzi Mountain.

sentences.zh: 成化四年遷於東莊坪。

translations.literal: Chenghua fourth year moved to Dongzhuangping.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 4 it was moved to Dongzhuangping.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十三年又遷鳳凰山麓，即今治也。

translations.literal: Chongzhen thirteenth year again moved to Phoenix Mountain foot, which is the present seat.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongzhen 13 it was moved again to the foot of Phoenix Mountain—the present seat.

sentences.zh: 東北有沮水。

translations.literal: Northeast has Ju River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Ju River.

sentences.zh: 歸州元治秭歸縣，直隸湖廣行省。

translations.literal: Guizhou zhou Yuan seat at Zigui County, directly subordinate Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou zhou under the Yuan was seated at Zigui County, directly subordinate to the Huguang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 洪武九年四月廢州入秭歸縣，屬夷陵州。

translations.literal: Hongwu ninth year fourth month abolished zhou and merged into Zigui County, belonged to Yiling zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Hongwu 9 the zhou was abolished and merged into Zigui County, subordinate to Yiling zhou.

sentences.zh: 十年二月改縣名長寧。

translations.literal: Tenth year second month changed county name to Changning.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 10 the county was renamed Changning.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月復改縣爲歸州。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year fifth month again changed county to Guizhou zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 13 the county was again made Guizhou zhou.

sentences.zh: 舊治江北，後治白沙南浦。

translations.literal: Old seat north of river, later seat at Baisha Nanpu.
translations.idiomatic: The old seat lay north of the river; the later seat was at Baisha Nanpu.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，徙治丹陽。

translations.literal: Hongwu beginning, moved seat to Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Hongwu the seat was moved to Danyang.

sentences.zh: 四年徙長寧，在江南楚王臺下。

translations.literal: Fourth year moved to Changning, south of river below King of Chu Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 it was moved to Changning, south of the river below the King of Chu Terrace.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖四十年復還江北舊治。

translations.literal: Jiajing fortieth year again returned to old seat north of river.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 40 it returned again to the old seat north of the river.

sentences.zh: 東有馬肝、白狗、空舲等峽。

translations.literal: East has Magan, Baigou, Kongling and other gorges.
translations.idiomatic: To the east are the Magan, Baigou, Kongling, and other gorges.

sentences.zh: 大江在州北，經峽中，入夷陵界。

translations.literal: Great River at north of zhou, passes through gorges, enters Yiling border.
translations.idiomatic: The Great River lies north of the zhou, passes through the gorges, and enters Yiling territory.

sentences.zh: 其西有叱灘、蓮花灘、新灘，皆濱江。

translations.literal: Its west has Chitan, Lianhua, Xin shoals, all along river.
translations.idiomatic: To its west are Chitan, Lianhua, and Xin shoals—all along the river.

sentences.zh: 西北有牛口巡檢司，後遷於巴東縣利洲。

translations.literal: Northwest has Niukou patrol inspectorate, later moved to Lizhou in Badong County.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest was the Niukou patrol inspectorate, later moved to Lizhou in Badong County.

sentences.zh: 東南有南邏口巡檢司，後遷於新灘。

translations.literal: Southeast has Nanluokou patrol inspectorate, later moved to Xin Shoal.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast was the Nanluokou patrol inspectorate, later moved to Xin Shoal.

sentences.zh: 東距府五百二十里。

translations.literal: East distance from fu five hundred twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay five hundred twenty li east of the fu.

sentences.zh: 領縣二：

translations.literal: Administers two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed two counties:

sentences.zh: 興山州西北。

translations.literal: Xingshan, zhou northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Xingshan lies northwest of the zhou.

sentences.zh: 洪武九年改屬夷陵州，後還屬。

translations.literal: Hongwu ninth year changed subordinate to Yiling zhou, later returned subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 9 it was transferred to Yiling zhou, then later returned to Guizhou's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 正統九年三月省入州。

translations.literal: Zhengtong ninth year third month reduced and merged into zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Zhengtong 9 it was reduced and merged into the zhou.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年五月復置。

translations.literal: Hongzhi third year fifth month again established.
translations.idiomatic: It was re-established in the fifth month of Hongzhi 3.

sentences.zh: 南有香溪，亦曰縣前河，南流入江。

translations.literal: South has Xiang Stream, also called County Front River, south flows into river.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Xiang Stream, also called the County Front River, which flows south into the river.

sentences.zh: 東北有高雞寨巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast has Gaojizhai patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Gaojizhai patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又東有桑林坪巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: Also east has Sanglinping patrol inspectorate, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the east was also the Sanglinping patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 又北有貓兒關，達鄖、襄。

translations.literal: Also north has Mao'er Pass, reaches Yun and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is also Mao'er Pass, reaching Yun and Xiang.

sentences.zh: 巴東州西。

translations.literal: Badong, zhou west.
translations.idiomatic: Badong lies west of the zhou.

sentences.zh: 元屬歸州。

translations.literal: Yuan belonged to Guizhou zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Guizhou zhou.

sentences.zh: 洪武九年改屬夷陵州。

translations.literal: Hongwu ninth year changed subordinate to Yiling zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 9 it was transferred to Yiling zhou.

sentences.zh: 隆慶四年還屬。

translations.literal: Longqing fourth year returned subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing 4 it was returned to Guizhou's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 北濱大江，自四川巫山縣流入，東經門扇、東奔、破石，謂之巴東三峽，下流至黃梅縣入南直宿松縣界。

translations.literal: North borders Great River, from Sichuan Wushan County flows in, east passes Menshan, Dongben, Poshi, called Badong Three Gorges, lower flow reaches Huangmei County and enters Nan Zhili Susong County border.
translations.idiomatic: To the north it borders the Great River, which flows in from Wushan County in Sichuan; eastward it passes Menshan, Dongben, and Poshi—the Badong Three Gorges—and downstream reaches Huangmei County before entering the border of Susong County in Nan Zhili.

sentences.zh: 又南有清江，一名夷水，自四川建始縣流入，下流入於大江。

translations.literal: Also south has Qing River, one name Yi water, from Sichuan Jianshi County flows in, lower flows into Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is also the Qing River, also called the Yi River, which flows in from Jianshi County in Sichuan and below enters the Great River.

sentences.zh: 又北有鹽井。

translations.literal: Also north has salt well.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is also a salt well.

sentences.zh: 西南有連天關巡檢司。

translations.literal: Southwest has Liantian Pass patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Liantian Pass patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 南有野山關巡檢司，本治石柱，隆慶四年更名。

translations.literal: South has Yeshan Pass patrol inspectorate, originally administered Shizhu, Longqing fourth year renamed.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Yeshan Pass patrol inspectorate, originally seated at Shizhu and renamed in Longqing 4.

sentences.zh: 襄陽府元襄陽路，屬河南江北行省。

translations.literal: Xiangyang fu Yuan Xiangyang Route, belonged to Henan-Jiangbei Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangyang Prefecture was the Yuan Xiangyang Route, subordinate to the Henan-Jiangbei Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 太祖甲辰年爲府，屬湖廣行省。

translations.literal: Taizu Jiachen year became fu, belonged to Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taizu Jiachen year it became a fu, subordinate to the Huguang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 九年屬湖廣佈政司。

translations.literal: Ninth year belonged to Huguang Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 it was placed under the Huguang Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 二十四年六月改屬河南，未幾，還屬湖廣。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year sixth month changed to belong to Henan, before long returned to Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 24 it was transferred to Henan, but before long was returned to Huguang.

sentences.zh: 領州一，縣六。

translations.literal: Administers one zhou, six counties.
translations.idiomatic: It governed one zhou and six counties.

sentences.zh: 東南距布政司六百八十里。

translations.literal: Southeast distance from Provincial Administration Commission six hundred eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay six hundred eighty li southeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 襄陽倚。

translations.literal: Xiangyang adjoins.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangyang County adjoined the seat.

sentences.zh: 正統元年，襄王府自長沙遷此。

translations.literal: Zhengtong first year, Xiang Prince mansion moved here from Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 1 the mansion of the Prince of Xiang was moved here from Changsha.

sentences.zh: 南有虎頭山，又有峴山。

translations.literal: South has Hutou Mountain, also has Xian Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south are Hutou Mountain and Xian Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東南有鹿門山。

translations.literal: Southeast has Lumen Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Lumen Mountain.

sentences.zh: 又西有隆中山。

translations.literal: Also west has Longzhong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is also Longzhong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 漢水在城北，亦曰襄江。

translations.literal: Han River at north of city, also called Xiang River.
translations.idiomatic: The Han River lies north of the city, also called the Xiang River.

sentences.zh: 白河在城東北，與唐河合，南入漢，謂之白河口，亦曰三州口。

translations.literal: Bai River at northeast of city, joins Tang River, south enters Han, called Baihekou, also called Sanzhoukou.
translations.idiomatic: The Bai River lies northeast of the city, joins the Tang River, and flows south into the Han at what is called Baihekou, also called Sanzhoukou.

sentences.zh: 又西北有青泥河，南有浮河，西南有檀溪，下流皆入於漢。

translations.literal: Also northwest has Qingni River, south has Fu River, southwest has Tan Stream, lower flows all enter Han.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is also the Qingni River; to the south the Fu River; and to the southwest the Tan Stream—all of whose lower courses enter the Han.

sentences.zh: 北有樊城，有樊城關巡檢司，後移於縣東北之柳樹頭。

translations.literal: North has Fancheng, has Fancheng Pass patrol inspectorate, later moved to Liushutou northeast of county.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Fancheng, with the Fancheng Pass patrol inspectorate, later moved to Liushutou northeast of the county.

sentences.zh: 又東北有雙溝口巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also northeast has Shuanggoukou patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is also the Shuanggoukou patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又西有油坊灘巡檢司，嘉靖十九年移於縣西北之北泰山廟鎮。

translations.literal: Also west has Youfangtan patrol inspectorate, Jiajing nineteenth year moved to Beitaishanmiao Town northwest of county.
translations.idiomatic: To the west was also the Youfangtan patrol inspectorate, moved in Jiajing 19 to Beitaishanmiao Town northwest of the county.

sentences.zh: 宜城府東南。

translations.literal: Yicheng, fu southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Yicheng lies southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 東有漢水。

translations.literal: East has Han River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Han River.

sentences.zh: 西有蠻水，亦曰夷水，源出房縣，流至縣界，入漢水，其支流曰長渠。

translations.literal: West has Man water, also called Yi water, source from Fang County, flows to county border, enters Han water, its branch called Changqu.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Man River, also called the Yi; it rises in Fang County, flows to the county border, and enters the Han, with a branch called the Changqu.

sentences.zh: 又有沶水，自漢中流入，合於蠻水，謂之沶口。

translations.literal: Also has Chi water, from Hanzhong flows in, joins Man water, called Chikou.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Chi River, which flows in from Hanzhong and joins the Man at what is called Chikou.

sentences.zh: 又有疏水，在縣東北，自南漳縣流入，注漢，謂之疏口。

translations.literal: Also has Shu water, in county northeast, from Nanzhang County flows in, pours into Han, called Shukou.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Shu River in the northeast of the county, which enters from Nanzhang County and empties into the Han at Shukou.

sentences.zh: 南漳府西南。

translations.literal: Nanzhang fu southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Nanzhang lies southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 西北有荊山。

translations.literal: Northwest has Jing Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Mt. Jing.

sentences.zh: 南有蠻水，又有沮水，又有漳河，流入當陽縣，合於沮水。

translations.literal: South has Man water, also has Ju water, also has Zhang River, flows into Dangyang County, joins Ju water.
translations.idiomatic: To the south are the Man and Ju rivers and the Zhang River, which flows into Dangyang County and joins the Ju.

sentences.zh: 東有方家堰、西南有金廂坪二巡檢司。

translations.literal: East has Fangjiayan, southwest has Jinxiangping two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the east are the Fangjiayan and Jinxiangping patrol inspectorates.

sentences.zh: 又西有七里頭巡檢司，後移於保康縣之常平堡。

translations.literal: Also west has Qilitou patrol inspectorate, later moved to Baokang County's Changping Fort.
translations.idiomatic: To the west was also the Qilitou patrol inspectorate, later moved to Changping Fort in Baokang County.

sentences.zh: 棗陽府東北。

translations.literal: Zaoyang fu northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Zaoyang lies northeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 洪武十年五月省入宜城縣，後復置。

translations.literal: Hongwu tenth year fifth month abolished and merged into Yicheng County, later again established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was abolished and merged into Yicheng County, then later re-established.

sentences.zh: 東南有白水，南有濜水流合焉，西流於沔水，此縣內之白水也。

translations.literal: Southeast has Baishui, south has Ying water flows to join, west flows into Mian water, this is the Baishui within this county.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Baishui; the Ying River joins it from the south and flows west into the Mian—this is the Baishui within the county.

sentences.zh: 又西南有滾河，流入襄陽之白河。

translations.literal: Also southwest has Gun River, flows into Xiangyang's Bai River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is also the Gun River, which flows into the Bai River at Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 東北有鹿頭店巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast has Lutoudian patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Lutoudian patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 谷城府西少北。

translations.literal: Gucheng fu west slightly north.
translations.idiomatic: Gucheng lies west and slightly north of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 東北有漢水，又有均水流入焉，謂之均口。

translations.literal: Northeast has Han water, also has Jun water flows in, called Junkou.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Han River; the Jun River also flows in there at Junkou.

sentences.zh: 又有築水，經縣治東南，注於漢水，曰築口。

translations.literal: Also has Zhu water, passes county seat southeast, pours into Han water, called Zhukou.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Zhu River, which passes southeast of the county seat and empties into the Han at Zhukou.

sentences.zh: 西有石花街巡檢司。

translations.literal: West has Shihua Street patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Shihua Street patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 光化府西北。

translations.literal: Guanghua fu northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghua lies northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 洪武十年省入谷城縣。

translations.literal: Hongwu tenth year abolished and merged into Gucheng County.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 10 it was abolished and merged into Gucheng County.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月復置。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year fifth month again established.
translations.idiomatic: It was re-established in the fifth month of year 13.

sentences.zh: 舊治在西。

translations.literal: Old seat was in the west.
translations.idiomatic: The former seat lay to the west.

sentences.zh: 隆慶末，改建於阜城衛，即今治也。

translations.literal: Longqing end, rebuilt at Fucheng Guard, that is the present seat.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Longqing reign it was rebuilt at Fucheng Guard, which is the present seat.

sentences.zh: 東有馬窟山。

translations.literal: East has Makou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Mt. Makou.

sentences.zh: 北有漢水。

translations.literal: North has Han water.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Han River.

sentences.zh: 東有白河，即氵肓水，自河南新野縣流入，有泌河流合焉。

translations.literal: East has Bai River, that is Huang water, from Henan Xinye County flows in, has Mi River flows to join.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Bai River, also called the Huang, which flows in from Xinye County in Henan; the Mi River joins it.

sentences.zh: 西北有左旗營巡檢司，萬曆中，徙於縣舊城。

translations.literal: Northwest has Zuoqiying patrol inspectorate, Wanli period moved to county old city.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest was the Zuoqiying patrol inspectorate, moved in the Wanli period to the county's old city.

sentences.zh: 均州洪武二年七月以州治武當縣省入。

translations.literal: Junzhou Hongwu second year seventh month by merging seat county Wudang abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Hongwu 2 Junzhou was abolished by merging its seat, Wudang County.

sentences.zh: 南有武當山，永樂中，尊爲太嶽太和山。

translations.literal: South has Wudang Mountain, Yongle period honored as Taiyue Taihe Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Mt. Wudang, honored in the Yongle reign as Taiyue Taihe Mountain.

sentences.zh: 山有二十七峯、三十六巖、二十四澗。

translations.literal: Mountain has twenty-seven peaks, thirty-six cliffs, twenty-four ravines.
translations.idiomatic: The mountain has twenty-seven peaks, thirty-six cliffs, and twenty-four ravines.

sentences.zh: 北有漢江，一名滄浪水。

translations.literal: North has Han River, one name Canglang water.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Han River, also called the Canglang.

sentences.zh: 東北有均水，自河南淅川縣流入。

translations.literal: Northeast has Jun water, from Henan Xichuan County flows in.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Jun River, which flows in from Xichuan County in Henan.

sentences.zh: 又東南有黑虎廟巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also southeast has Heihu Temple patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is also the Heihu Temple patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 東南距府三百九十里。

translations.literal: Southeast distance from fu three hundred ninety li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies three hundred ninety li southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 鄖陽府成化十二年十二月置。

translations.literal: Yunyang fu Chenghua twelfth year twelfth month established.
translations.idiomatic: Yunyang Prefecture was established in the twelfth month of Chenghua 12.

sentences.zh: 領縣七。

translations.literal: Administers seven counties.
translations.idiomatic: It governed seven counties.

sentences.zh: 又置湖廣行都指揮使司於此。

translations.literal: Also established Huguang regional commander-in-chief's office here.
translations.idiomatic: The Huguang regional commander-in-chief's office was also established here.

sentences.zh: 衛所俱無實土。

translations.literal: Guards and posts all had no real land.
translations.idiomatic: The guards and posts all held no substantive territory.

sentences.zh: 東南距布政司千二百里。

translations.literal: Southeast distance from provincial administration commission one thousand two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one thousand two hundred li southeast of the provincial administration commission.

sentences.zh: 鄖倚。

translations.literal: Yun adjoins.
translations.idiomatic: Yun County adjoined the seat.

sentences.zh: 元屬均州。

translations.literal: Yuan belonged to Junzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Junzhou.

sentences.zh: 成化十二年置鄖陽府，治此。

translations.literal: Chenghua twelfth year established Yunyang fu, seat here.
translations.idiomatic: When Yunyang Prefecture was established in Chenghua 12, the seat was placed here.

sentences.zh: 漢水在南。

translations.literal: Han water in south.
translations.idiomatic: The Han River lay to the south.

sentences.zh: 東南有龍門山，龍門河出焉，下流入於漢水。

translations.literal: Southeast has Longmen Mountain, Longmen River issues there, downstream flows into Han water.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Mt. Longmen, whence the Longmen River issues and flows down into the Han.

sentences.zh: 西北有青桐關。

translations.literal: Northwest has Qingtong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Qingtong Pass.

sentences.zh: 東北有雷峯、椏鎮二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast has Leifeng, Yazhen two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast are the Leifeng and Yazhen patrol inspectorates.

sentences.zh: 房府南少西。

translations.literal: Fang fu south slightly west.
translations.idiomatic: Fang County lies south and slightly west of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 元房州，屬襄陽路。

translations.literal: Yuan Fangzhou, belonged to Xiangyang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Fangzhou, subordinate to Xiangyang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武十年五月以州治房陵縣省入，又降州爲縣，仍屬襄陽府。

translations.literal: Hongwu tenth year fifth month by merging seat county Fangling abolished, also demoted zhou to county, still belonged to Xiangyang fu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 the zhou was abolished by merging its seat, Fangling County, then demoted to a county still under Xiangyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 成化十二年十二月來屬。

translations.literal: Chenghua twelfth year twelfth month came to belong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Chenghua 12 it was placed under the new prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西南有景山，一名雁山，沮水出焉，流入遠安縣界。

translations.literal: Southwest has Jing Mountain, one name Yan Mountain, Ju water issues there, flows into Yuan'an County border.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Mt. Jing, also called Mt. Yan, whence the Ju River issues and flows into Yuan'an County.

sentences.zh: 又南有粉水，亦曰彭水，又有築水，俱流入谷城縣，注漢。

translations.literal: Also south has Fen water, also called Peng water, also has Zhu water, all flow into Gucheng County, pour into Han.
translations.idiomatic: To the south are also the Fen River, also called the Peng, and the Zhu River, all of which flow into Gucheng County and empty into the Han.

sentences.zh: 西南有板橋山巡檢司，後移於縣東南之博磨坪。

translations.literal: Southwest has Banqiao Mountain patrol inspectorate, later moved to county southeast's Bomo Flat.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest was the Banqiao Mountain patrol inspectorate, later moved to Bomo Flat southeast of the county.

sentences.zh: 竹山府西南。

translations.literal: Zhushan fu southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Zhushan lies southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 元屬房州。

translations.literal: Yuan belonged to Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 洪武十年五月省入房縣。

translations.literal: Hongwu tenth year fifth month abolished and merged into Fang County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was abolished and merged into Fang County.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月復置，屬襄陽府。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year fifth month again established, belonged to Xiangyang fu.
translations.idiomatic: It was re-established in the fifth month of year 13 and placed under Xiangyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 成化十二年十二月來屬。

translations.literal: Chenghua twelfth year twelfth month came to belong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Chenghua 12 it was placed under the new prefecture.

sentences.zh: 東有方城山。

translations.literal: East has Fangcheng Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Mt. Fangcheng.

sentences.zh: 西有築山，築水出焉，流入房縣界。

translations.literal: West has Zhu Mountain, Zhu water issues there, flows into Fang County border.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Mt. Zhu, whence the Zhu River issues and flows into Fang County.

sentences.zh: 又有上庸山，上庸水所出，南合孔陽水，下流入漢。

translations.literal: Also has Shangyong Mountain, Shangyong water issues, south joins Kongyang water, downstream flows into Han.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Mt. Shangyong, source of the Shangyong River, which southward joins the Kongyang and flows down into the Han.

sentences.zh: 又南有堵水，源出陝西平利縣界，東流入漢。

translations.literal: Also south has Du water, source from Shaanxi Pingli County border, east flows into Han.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is also the Du River, rising on the border of Pingli County in Shaanxi and flowing east into the Han.

sentences.zh: 西北有黃茅關、吉陽關二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northwest has Huangmao Pass, Jiyang Pass two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest are the Huangmao Pass and Jiyang Pass patrol inspectorates.

sentences.zh: 竹溪府西南。

translations.literal: Zhuxi fu southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuxi lies southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 本竹山縣之尹店巡檢司，成化十二年十二月改置縣，而移巡檢司於縣東之縣河鎮，尋又遷巡檢司於白土關。

translations.literal: Originally Zhushan County's Yindian patrol inspectorate, Chenghua twelfth year twelfth month changed to establish county, and moved patrol inspectorate to county east's Xianhe Town, soon again moved patrol inspectorate to Baituguan.
translations.idiomatic: It was originally the Yindian patrol inspectorate of Zhushan County; in the twelfth month of Chenghua 12 a county was established and the inspectorate moved to Xianhe Town east of the seat, then soon relocated again to Baituguan.

sentences.zh: 南有竹溪河。

translations.literal: South has Zhuxi River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Zhuxi River.

sentences.zh: 上津府西北。

translations.literal: Shangjin fu northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Shangjin lies northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 洪武初置，屬襄陽府。

translations.literal: Hongwu beginning established, belonged to Xiangyang fu.
translations.idiomatic: It was established at the beginning of Hongwu and placed under Xiangyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十年五月省入鄖陽。

translations.literal: Tenth year fifth month abolished and merged into Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 10 it was abolished and merged into Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月復置，仍屬襄陽府。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year fifth month again established, still belonged to Xiangyang fu.
translations.idiomatic: It was re-established in the fifth month of year 13 and remained under Xiangyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 成化十二年十二月來屬。

translations.literal: Chenghua twelfth year twelfth month came to belong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Chenghua 12 it was placed under the new prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西有十八盤山，又有吉水，西南流入漢，俗謂之夾河。

translations.literal: West has Eighteen Bends Mountain, also has Ji water, southwest flows into Han, vulgarly called Jia River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Mt. Shibapan and the Ji River, which flows southwest into the Han and is commonly called the Jia River.

sentences.zh: 南有江口鎮巡檢司。

translations.literal: South has Jiangkou Town patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Jiangkou Town patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 鄖西府西北。

translations.literal: Yunxi fu northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Yunxi lies northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 成化十二年十二月以鄖縣之南門保置。

translations.literal: Chenghua twelfth year twelfth month by Yun County's Nanmen Fort established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Chenghua 12 it was established from Nanmen Fort in Yun County.

sentences.zh: 南有漢江，自陝西白河縣流入，下流至漢陽縣入於江。

translations.literal: South has Han River, from Shaanxi Baihe County flows in, downstream reaches Hanyang County enters into Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Han River, which flows in from Baihe County in Shaanxi and downstream reaches Hanyang County before entering the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 保康府東南。

translations.literal: Baokang fu southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Baokang lies southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 弘治十年十一月以房縣之潭頭坪置。

translations.literal: Hongzhi tenth year eleventh month by Fang County's Tantou Flat established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Hongzhi 10 it was established from Tantou Flat in Fang County.

sentences.zh: 北有粉水，東南有常平堡，嘉靖十九年移南漳縣之七里頭巡檢司於此。

translations.literal: North has Fen water, southeast has Changping Fort, Jiajing nineteenth year moved Nanzhang County's Qilitou patrol inspectorate here.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Fen River; to the southeast is Changping Fort, and in Jiajing 19 the Qilitou patrol inspectorate was moved here from Nanzhang County.

sentences.zh: 長沙府元天臨路，屬湖南道宣慰司。

translations.literal: Changsha fu Yuan Tianlin Circuit, belonged to Hunan Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Changsha Prefecture was the Yuan Tianlin Circuit, subordinate to the Hunan Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 太祖甲辰年爲潭州府。

translations.literal: Taizu Jiachen year became Tanzhou fu.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taizu Jiachen year it became Tanzhou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武五年六月更名長沙。

translations.literal: Hongwu fifth year sixth month renamed Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Hongwu 5 it was renamed Changsha.

sentences.zh: 領州一，縣十一。

translations.literal: Administers one zhou, eleven counties.
translations.idiomatic: It governed one zhou and eleven counties.

sentences.zh: 東北距布政司八百八十里。

translations.literal: Northeast distance from provincial administration commission eight hundred eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay eight hundred eighty li northeast of the provincial administration commission.

sentences.zh: 長沙倚。

translations.literal: Changsha adjoins.
translations.idiomatic: Changsha County adjoined the seat.

sentences.zh: 治西北。

translations.literal: Seat northwest.
translations.idiomatic: The seat lay northwest of the county.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年四月建潭王府，二十三年除。

translations.literal: Hongwu third year fourth month built Tan Prince mansion, twenty-third year abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Hongwu 3 the mansion of the Prince of Tan was built; it was abolished in year 23.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年，谷王府自北直宣府遷於此，十五年除。

translations.literal: Yongle first year, Gu Prince mansion from North Direct Xuanfu moved here, fifteenth year abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 1 the mansion of the Prince of Gu was moved here from Xuanfu in the Northern Direct Region and abolished in year 15.

sentences.zh: 二十二年建襄王府，正統元年遷於襄陽。

translations.literal: Twenty-second year built Xiang Prince mansion, Zhengtong first year moved to Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 the mansion of the Prince of Xiang was built; in Zhengtong 1 it was moved to Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 天順元年三月建吉王府。

translations.literal: Tianshun first year third month built Ji Prince mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Tianshun 1 the mansion of the Prince of Ji was built.

sentences.zh: 縣舊治城外，洪武初，徙城中。

translations.literal: County old seat outside city, Hongwu beginning moved into city.
translations.idiomatic: The county's former seat lay outside the city wall; at the beginning of Hongwu it was moved within the city.

sentences.zh: 十八年復徙北門外。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year again moved outside North Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 it was moved again outside the North Gate.

sentences.zh: 萬曆二十四年徙朝宗門內。

translations.literal: Wanli twenty-fourth year moved inside Chaozong Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 24 it was moved inside Chaozong Gate.

sentences.zh: 西有湘水，源出廣西興安縣，流入境，合瀟水、烝水北流，環府城，東北出至湘陰縣，達青草湖，注洞庭湖，行二千五百餘里。

translations.literal: West has Xiang water, source from Guangxi Xing'an County, flows into border, joins Xiao water, Zheng water north flow, circles fu city, northeast exits to Xiangyin County, reaches Qingcao Lake, pours into Dongting Lake, course two thousand five hundred plus li.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Xiang River, rising in Xing'an County in Guangxi; it enters the prefecture, joins the Xiao and Zheng flowing north, encircles the prefectural city, exits northeast toward Xiangyin County, reaches Qingcao Lake, and empties into Dongting Lake—a course of more than two thousand five hundred li.

sentences.zh: 北有瀏陽水，西流入湘，謂之瀏口。

translations.literal: North has Liuyang water, west flows into Xiang, called Liukou.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Liuyang River, which flows west into the Xiang at Liukou.

sentences.zh: 又有麻溪，流入湘水，曰麻溪口。

translations.literal: Also has Maxi, flows into Xiang water, called Maxikou.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Maxi, which flows into the Xiang at Maxikou.

sentences.zh: 又西北有喬口巡檢司，喬江與澬江合流處。

translations.literal: Also northwest has Qiaokou patrol inspectorate, Qiao River and Zi River confluence place.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is also the Qiaokou patrol inspectorate, at the confluence of the Qiao and Zi rivers.

sentences.zh: 善化倚。

translations.literal: Shanhua adjoins.
translations.idiomatic: Shanhua County adjoined the seat.

sentences.zh: 治東南。

translations.literal: Seat southeast.
translations.idiomatic: The seat lay southeast of the county.

sentences.zh: 舊治在城外，洪武四年徙於城中。

translations.literal: Old seat outside city, Hongwu fourth year moved into city.
translations.idiomatic: The former seat lay outside the city; in Hongwu 4 it was moved within the walls.

sentences.zh: 十年五月省入長沙縣。

translations.literal: Tenth year fifth month abolished and merged into Changsha County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 10 it was abolished and merged into Changsha County.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月復置，治在南門外。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year fifth month re-established, seat outside South Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 13 it was re-established, with the seat outside the South Gate.

sentences.zh: 成化十八年仍徙城中。

translations.literal: Chenghua eighteenth year again moved into city.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 18 it was moved back within the city walls.

sentences.zh: 西南有嶽麓山，湘江繞其東麓。

translations.literal: Southwest has Mt. Yuelu, Xiang River wraps its eastern foothills.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Mt. Yuelu, with the Xiang River skirting its eastern foothills.

sentences.zh: 又有靳江，流入湘江。

translations.literal: Also has Jin River, flows into Xiang River.
