translations.idiomatic: To the west is Mount Heng, with seventy-two peaks, ten caves, fifteen eminences, thirty-eight springs, twenty-five streams, nine pools, nine ponds, and nine wells; the greatest peaks are Zhu Rong, Zi Gai, Yun Mi, Shi Lin, and Tian Zhu, of which Zhu Rong is the highest.

sentences.zh: 東有湘江。

translations.literal: East has Xiang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Xiang River.

sentences.zh: 東南有茶陵江，即洣水也，自攸縣合攸水流入境，注於湘，曰茶陵口。

translations.literal: Southeast has Chaling River, namely Mi River, from You county joins You River enters territory, empties into Xiang, called Chaling Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Chaling River—the Mi River—which, having joined the You River in You County, enters the county and empties into the Xiang at Chaling Mouth.

sentences.zh: 東有草市、東南有雷家埠二巡檢司。

translations.literal: East has Cao Market, southeast has Leijia Bu two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Cao Market patrol inspectorate and to the southeast the Leijia Bu patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 耒陽府東南。

translations.literal: Leiyang, prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Leiyang County lay southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 元耒陽州，直隸湖南道。

translations.literal: Yuan Leiyang zhou, directly subordinate Hunan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Leiyang Zhou, directly subordinate to the Hunan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年三月降爲縣。

translations.literal: Hongwu third year third month reduced to county.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Hongwu 3 it was reduced to a county.

sentences.zh: 耒水在北。

translations.literal: Lei River in north.
translations.idiomatic: The Lei River lay to the north.

sentences.zh: 東有侯計山，肥水出焉，西南入耒水。

translations.literal: East has Houji Mountain, Fei River emerges, southwest enters Lei River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Houji Mountain, whence the Fei River flows southwest into the Lei.

sentences.zh: 又西南有羅渡巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also southwest has Luodu patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest is the Luodu patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 常寧府南。

translations.literal: Changning, prefecture south.
translations.idiomatic: Changning County lay south of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 元常寧州，直隸湖南道。

translations.literal: Yuan Changning zhou, directly subordinate Hunan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Changning Zhou, directly subordinate to the Hunan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年三月降爲縣。

translations.literal: Hongwu third year third month reduced to county.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Hongwu 3 it was reduced to a county.

sentences.zh: 西北有湘水，東有舂陵水合焉。

translations.literal: Northwest has Xiang River, east has Chunling River joins.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Xiang River; to the east the Chunling River joins it.

sentences.zh: 安仁府東少北。

translations.literal: Anren, prefecture east slightly north.
translations.idiomatic: Anren County lay slightly north of east from the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 西有楊梅峯。

translations.literal: West has Yangmei Peak.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Yangmei Peak.

sentences.zh: 南有小江水，自郴州流入，西北流至衡山縣，合於洣水。

translations.literal: South has Xiaojiang River, from Chenzhou enters, northwest flows to Hengshan county, joins Mi River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Xiaojiang River, which enters from Chenzhou, flows northwest to Hengshan County, and joins the Mi River.

sentences.zh: 南有安平、北有潭湖二巡檢司。

translations.literal: South has Anping, north has Tanhu two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Anping patrol inspectorate and to the north the Tanhu patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 靈阝府東。

translations.literal: Ling, prefecture east.
translations.idiomatic: Ling County lay east of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 洣水在縣東，源出洣泉，西有云秋水流合焉。

translations.literal: Mi River in county east, source emerges Mi Spring, west Yunqiu River flows joins.
translations.idiomatic: The Mi River lay east of the county; its source is Mi Spring, and from the west the Yunqiu River joins it.

sentences.zh: 臨武州南。

translations.literal: Linwu zhou, south.
translations.idiomatic: Linwu Zhou lay to the south.

sentences.zh: 西北有舜峯山。

translations.literal: Northwest has Shun Peak Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Shun Peak Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西有西山，武水出焉，經宜章縣合於章水。

translations.literal: West has West Mountain, Wu River emerges, passes Yizhang county joins Zhang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is West Mountain, whence the Wu River flows through Yizhang County to join the Zhang River.

sentences.zh: 東北有兩路口巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast has Lianglukou patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Lianglukou patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又東有赤土巡檢，後廢。

translations.literal: Also east has Chitu patrol inspector, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east was the Chitu patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 藍山州西南。

translations.literal: Lanshan zhou, southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Lanshan Zhou lay to the southwest.

sentences.zh: 舊治在縣北，洪武元年徙於此，屬郴州。

translations.literal: Old seat in county north, Hongwu first year moved here, belonged to Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The old seat lay north of the county; in Hongwu 1 it was moved to the present site and placed under Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 二年來屬。

translations.literal: Second year came subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2 it was brought under direct subordination.

sentences.zh: 南有黃檗山。

translations.literal: South has Huangbo Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Huangbo Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東南有華陰山。

translations.literal: Southeast has Huayin Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Huayin Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西南有九疑山，山有杞林峯，巋水出焉，亦名舜水，北流合舂陵水。

translations.literal: Southwest has Jiuyi Mountain, mountain has Qilin Peak, Kui River emerges, also named Shun River, north flow joins Chunling River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Mount Jiuyi; on it is Qilin Peak, whence the Kui River—also called the Shun River—flows north to join the Chunling River.

sentences.zh: 又西有守禦寧溪千戶所，洪武二十九年三月置。

translations.literal: Also west has garrison-defense Ningxi thousand-household post, Hongwu twenty-ninth year third month established.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Ningxi garrison-defense thousand-household post, established in the third month of Hongwu 29.

sentences.zh: 東有毛俊鎮、北有乾溪鎮、西南有大橋鎮三巡檢司。

translations.literal: East has Maojun town, north has Qianxi town, southwest has Daqiao town three patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Maojun town, to the north Qianxi town, and to the southwest Daqiao town—three patrol inspectorates.

sentences.zh: 又西有小山堡、張家陂二巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: Also west has Xiaoshan fort, Zhangjiabei two patrol inspectorates, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west were the Xiaoshan Fort and Zhangjiabei patrol inspectorates, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 嘉禾州西南。

translations.literal: Jiahe zhou, southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Jiahe Zhou lay to the southwest.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十二年以桂陽州之倉禾堡置，析臨武縣地益之。

translations.literal: Chongzhen twelfth year using Guiyang zhou's Canghe fort established, split Linwu county territory to enlarge.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongzhen 12 it was established from Canghe Fort of Guiyang Zhou, with territory taken from Linwu County to enlarge it.

sentences.zh: 東南有巋水，自藍山縣流入，北經石門山，又東北入州界。

translations.literal: Southeast has Kui River, from Lanshan county enters, north passes Shimen mountain, also northeast enters zhou territory.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Kui River, which enters from Lanshan County, flows north past Shimen Mountain, and then northeast into the zhou.

sentences.zh: 永州府元永州路，屬湖南道宣慰司。

translations.literal: Yongzhou prefecture Yuan Yongzhou route, belonged to Hunan circuit Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzhou Prefecture was Yongzhou Route under the Yuan, subordinate to the Hunan Circuit Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年爲府。

translations.literal: Hongwu first year became prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 it was made a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領州一，縣七。

translations.literal: Governing zhou one, counties seven.
translations.idiomatic: It governed one zhou and seven counties.

sentences.zh: 東北距布政司千八百二十里。

translations.literal: Northeast distance from Provincial Administration Commission one thousand eight hundred twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one thousand eight hundred twenty li northeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 零陵倚。

translations.literal: Lingling, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Lingling was the attached seat county.

sentences.zh: 北有湘水，經城西，瀟水自南來合焉，謂之湘口，有湘口關。

translations.literal: North has Xiang River, passes west of city, Xiao River from south comes joins, called Xiang Mouth, has Xiang Mouth pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the north the Xiang River passes west of the city; the Xiao River comes from the south to join it at Xiang Mouth, where Xiang Mouth Pass stands.

sentences.zh: 又南有永水，源出縣西南之永山，北流入於湘水。

translations.literal: Also south has Yong River, source emerges county southwest Yong Mountain, north enters Xiang River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is the Yong River, which rises at Yong Mountain in the southwest of the county and flows north into the Xiang.

sentences.zh: 北有黃楊堡巡檢司，本高溪市，隆慶元年徙治，更名。

translations.literal: North has Huangyang Fort patrol inspectorate, originally Gaoxi market, Longqing first year moved governance, renamed.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Huangyang Fort patrol inspectorate, originally Gaoxi Market; in Longqing 1 its seat was moved and it was renamed.

sentences.zh: 祁陽府東北。

translations.literal: Qiyang, prefecture northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Qiyang County lay northeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 舊治在縣西，景泰元年十二月徙於今治。

translations.literal: Old seat in county west, Jingtai first year twelfth month moved to present seat.
translations.idiomatic: The old seat lay west of the county; in the twelfth month of Jingtai 1 it was moved to the present site.

sentences.zh: 北有祁山，上有黃羆鎮。

translations.literal: North has Qi Mountain, above has Huangpi town.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Qi Mountain, on which stands Huangpi town.

sentences.zh: 西北有四望山。

translations.literal: Northwest has Siwang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Siwang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西有湘水。

translations.literal: West has Xiang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Xiang River.

sentences.zh: 又城北有祁水，源出邵陽縣，東北流入焉。

translations.literal: Also north of city has Qi River, source emerges Shaoyang county, northeast enters.
translations.idiomatic: North of the city is also the Qi River, which rises in Shaoyang County and enters from the northeast.

sentences.zh: 南有浯溪，下流亦入湘水。

translations.literal: South has Wuxi, lower flow also enters Xiang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Wuxi, whose lower course also enters the Xiang.

sentences.zh: 又東有歸陽市、東南有白水市、西北有水隆太平市三巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also east has Guiyang Market, southeast has Baishui Market, northwest has Shuilong Taiping Market three patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is the Guiyang Market patrol inspectorate, to the southeast the Baishui Market patrol inspectorate, and to the northwest the Shuilong Taiping Market patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又東北有湘江市巡檢司，後移於縣東北之排山。

translations.literal: Also northeast has Xiangjiang Market patrol inspectorate, later moved to county east-northeast Pai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northeast was the Xiangjiang Market patrol inspectorate, later moved to Pai Mountain northeast of the county.

sentences.zh: 東安府西北。

translations.literal: Dong'an, prefecture northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Dong'an County lay northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 八十四渡山在縣東。

translations.literal: Eighty-four Ford Mountain in county east.
translations.idiomatic: Eighty-four Ford Mountain lies east of the county.

sentences.zh: 又東南有湘水，自廣西全州流入。

translations.literal: Also southeast has Xiang River, from Guangxi Quanzhou enters.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast the Xiang River enters from Quanzhou in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 又有盧洪江，源出縣北九龍巖，經城東，下流入湘水。

translations.literal: Also has Luhong River, source emerges county north Jiulong Rock, passes east of city, lower flow enters Xiang River.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Luhong River, which rises at Jiulong Rock north of the county, passes east of the city, and below enters the Xiang.

sentences.zh: 有盧洪市巡檢司。

translations.literal: Has Luhong Market patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: It has the Luhong Market patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又有結陂市巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: Also has Jiebei Market patrol inspectorate, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the Jiebei Market patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 道州元道州路，屬湖南宣慰司。

translations.literal: Daozhou Yuan Daozhou route, belonged to Hunan Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Daozhou was Daozhou Route under the Yuan, subordinate to the Hunan Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年爲府。

translations.literal: Hongwu first year became prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 it was made a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九年四月復降爲州，以州治營道縣省入，來屬。

translations.literal: Ninth year fourth month again reduced to zhou, using zhou seat Yingdao county incorporated, came subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 9 it was again reduced to a zhou; its seat county Yingdao was incorporated, and it was placed under Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 西有營山，營水出焉，至泥江，與江華縣之沲水合。

translations.literal: West has Ying Mountain, Ying River emerges, to Nijiang with Jianghua county's Tuo River joins.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Ying Mountain, whence the Ying River flows to Nijiang and joins the Tuo River of Jianghua County.

sentences.zh: 東有瀟江，至青口，合於沲水。

translations.literal: East has Xiao River, to Qing Mouth joins with Tuo River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Xiao River, which at Qing Mouth joins the Tuo.

sentences.zh: 又西有濂溪，源出州西安定山下，東北合宜水，謂之龍灘，下流俱入湘水。

translations.literal: Also west has Lianxi, source emerges zhou southwest An Ding Mountain, northeast joins Yi River, called Longtan, lower flows all enter Xiang River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is the Lianxi, which rises at An Ding Mountain southwest of the zhou, flows northeast to join the Yi at Longtan, and below both enter the Xiang.

sentences.zh: 北距府百五十里。

translations.literal: North distance from prefecture one hundred fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred fifty li north of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 領縣四：

translations.literal: Governing counties four:
translations.idiomatic: It governed four counties:

sentences.zh: 寧遠州東少北。

translations.literal: Ningyuan zhou, east slightly north.
translations.idiomatic: Ningyuan Zhou lay slightly north of east from the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 南有九疑山，介衡、永、郴、道之間。

translations.literal: South has Jiuyi Mountain, between Heng, Yong, Chen, Dao.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Mount Jiuyi, lying between Hengyang, Yongzhou, Chenzhou, and Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 山有硃明峯，瀟水出焉。

translations.literal: Mountain has Vermillion Brightness Peak, Xiao River emerges.
translations.idiomatic: On the mountain is Vermillion Brightness Peak, whence the Xiao River flows.

sentences.zh: 又南有舜源水，北流與江華縣沲、瀟二水合爲三江口。

translations.literal: Also south has Shunyuan River, north flow with Jianghua county Tuo, Xiao two rivers merge at Sanjiang Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is the Shunyuan River, which flows north and, with the Tuo and Xiao rivers of Jianghua County, forms Sanjiang Mouth.

sentences.zh: 南有九疑、魯觀巡檢司，在九疑、魯觀二峒口。

translations.literal: South has Jiuyi, Luguan patrol inspectorates, at Jiuyi, Luguan two cave mouths.
translations.idiomatic: To the south are the Jiuyi and Luguan patrol inspectorates, at the mouths of the Jiuyi and Luguan cave settlements.

sentences.zh: 江華州南。

translations.literal: Jianghua zhou, south.
translations.idiomatic: Jianghua Zhou lay to the south.

sentences.zh: 東南有故城。

translations.literal: Southeast has old city.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the old city.

sentences.zh: 今治本寧遠衛右千戶所，洪武二十八年置。

translations.literal: Present seat at Beningyuan Guard right thousand-household post, Hongwu twenty-eighth year established.
translations.idiomatic: The present seat is at the right thousand-household post of Beningyuan Guard, established in Hongwu 28.

sentences.zh: 天順六年徙縣來同治。

translations.literal: Tianshun sixth year moved county to jointly govern.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 6 the county seat was moved to govern jointly with it.

sentences.zh: 西有白芒嶺，即萌渚嶺，五嶺之第四嶺也。

translations.literal: West has Baimang Ridge, namely Mengzhu Ridge, Five Ridges' fourth ridge.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Baimang Ridge—also called Mengzhu Ridge—the fourth of the Five Ridges.

sentences.zh: 東有沲水，源出九疑山之石城、娥皇二峯，下流合於瀟水。

translations.literal: East has Tuo River, source emerges Jiuyi Mountain's Shicheng, Ehuang two peaks, lower flow joins Xiao River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Tuo River, which rises at the Shicheng and Ehuang peaks of Mount Jiuyi and below joins the Xiao.

sentences.zh: 又東南有砅水，源出九疑山之女英峯，流合沲水。

translations.literal: Also southeast has Fei River, source emerges Jiuyi Mountain's Nuying Peak, flows joins Tuo River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast is the Fei River, which rises at Nuying Peak on Mount Jiuyi and flows into the Tuo.

sentences.zh: 又東有守禦錦田千戶所，洪武二十九年置。

translations.literal: Also east has garrison-defense Jintian thousand-household post, Hongwu twenty-ninth year established.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is the Jintian garrison-defense thousand-household post, established in Hongwu 29.

sentences.zh: 又有錦田巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also has Jintian patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Jintian patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又西南有錦岡巡檢司，又有濤墟市巡檢司，後移於寧遠縣之九疑、魯觀。

translations.literal: Also southwest has Jingang patrol inspectorate, also has Taoxu Market patrol inspectorate, later moved to Ningyuan county's Jiuyi, Luguan.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest is the Jingang patrol inspectorate; there was also the Taoxu Market patrol inspectorate, later moved to Jiuyi and Luguan in Ningyuan County.

sentences.zh: 永明州西少南。

translations.literal: Yongming zhou, west slightly south.
translations.idiomatic: Yongming Zhou lay slightly south of west from the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 北有永明嶺，即都龐嶺，五嶺之第三嶺也。

translations.literal: North has Yongming Ridge, namely Dulou Ridge, Five Ridges' third ridge.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Yongming Ridge—also called Dulou Ridge—the third of the Five Ridges.

sentences.zh: 南有遨水，自廣西富川縣流入，下流注於瀟水。

translations.literal: South has Aoshui, from Guangxi Fuchuan County flows in, lower flow enters Xiao River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Aoshui, which enters from Fuchuan County in Guangxi and below discharges into the Xiao River.

sentences.zh: 東南有枇杷守禦千戶所，西南有桃川守禦千戶所，俱洪武二十九年置。

translations.literal: Southeast has Pipao garrison-defense thousand-household post, southwest has Taochuan garrison-defense thousand-household post, both Hongwu twenty-ninth year established.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Pipao garrison-defense thousand-household post and to the southwest the Taochuan garrison-defense thousand-household post; both were established in Hongwu 29.

sentences.zh: 又有桃川市巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also has Taochuan Market patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Taochuan Market patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又西南有白麪墟巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also southwest has Baimianxu patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest is the Baimianxu patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 新田州東北。

translations.literal: Xintian Zhou, northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Xintian Zhou lay to the northeast.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十二年以寧遠縣之新田堡置。

translations.literal: Chongzhen twelfth year from Ningyuan County's Xintian Fort established.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongzhen 12 it was established from Xintian Fort in Ningyuan County.

sentences.zh: 西北有舂陵山，與寧遠縣界，舂陵水出焉，下流至常寧縣，合於湘水。

translations.literal: Northwest has Chunling Mountain, borders Ningyuan County, Chunling River emerges thereof, lower flow reaches Changning County, joins Xiang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Mount Chunling, on the border with Ningyuan County; the Chunling River rises there, flows down to Changning County, and joins the Xiang.

sentences.zh: 東南有白麪寨巡檢司。

translations.literal: Southeast has Baimianzhai patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Baimianzhai patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 寶慶府元寶慶路，屬湖南道宣慰司。

translations.literal: Baoxing Prefecture Yuan Baoxing Route, belonged to Hunan Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Baoxing Prefecture was the Yuan Baoxing Route, subordinate to the Hunan Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年爲府。

translations.literal: Hongwu first year became prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 it became a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領州一，縣四。

translations.literal: Administers zhou one, counties four.

sentences.zh: 又西南有上沃埠巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: Also southwest has Shangwobu patrol inspectorate, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest was the Shangwobu patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

translations.literal: Changxing, northwest of prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Changxing lay to the northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 元長興州。

translations.literal: Yuan Changxing zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Changxing Zhou.

sentences.zh: 太祖丁酉年三月改名長官州，壬寅年復曰長興。

translations.literal: Taizu ding-you year third month changed name to Changguan zhou, ren-yin year restored to Changxing.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Taizu's ding-you year it was renamed Changguan Zhou; in the ren-yin year it was restored to Changxing.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年降爲縣。

translations.literal: Hongwu second year reduced to county.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2 it was reduced to a county.

sentences.zh: 西北有顧渚山，產茶，一名西顧山，一名吳望山。

translations.literal: Northwest has Guzhu Mountain, produces tea, one name West Gu Mountain, one name Wuwang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Mount Guzhu, famed for tea, also called Mount West Gu and Mount Wuwang.

sentences.zh: 東北有太湖，與南直宜興縣分中流爲界。

translations.literal: Northeast has Tai Lake, with Nanzhili Yixing county divide midstream as border.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Lake Tai, whose midstream forms the boundary with Yixing County in Nanzhili.

sentences.zh: 西有箬溪，下流入太湖。

translations.literal: West has Ruo Stream, lower flow enters Tai Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Ruo Stream, which flows down into Lake Tai.

sentences.zh: 西南有荊溪，東南入於苕溪。

translations.literal: Southwest has Jing Stream, southeast enters in Tiao River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Jing Stream, which flows southeast into the Tiao River.

sentences.zh: 東北有皋塘、西南有四安二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast has Gaotang, southwest has Si'an two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Gaotang patrol inspectorate and to the southwest the Si'an patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又西有合溪、南有和平二巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: Also west has Hexi, south has Heping two patrol inspectorates, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west were the Hexi and Heping patrol inspectorates, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 德清府南少東。

translations.literal: Deqing, south slightly east of prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Deqing lay slightly southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 東北有敢三山。

translations.literal: Northeast has Gansan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Gansan Mountain.

translations.literal: Southeast has Grand Canal, has Yubu Stream, also called Zha Stream, that is Tiao River alias.

sentences.zh: 東北有新市鎮巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northeast has Xinshi town patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Xinshi town patrol inspectorate.

translations.literal: Also east has Xiatang patrol inspectorate, later moved to Wuliu Harbor mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east was the Xiatang patrol inspectorate, later moved to Wuliu Harbor mouth.

sentences.zh: 又東有荷葉浦巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: Also east has Heyepu patrol inspectorate, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east was the Heyepu patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 武康府西南。

translations.literal: Wukang, southwest of prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wukang lay to the southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 東有封山，一名防風山。

translations.literal: East has Feng Mountain, one name Fangfeng Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Mount Feng, also called Mount Fangfeng.

sentences.zh: 又有禺山。

translations.literal: Also has Yu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Mount Yu.

sentences.zh: 西南有覆舟山。

translations.literal: Southwest has Fuzhou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Fuzhou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 南有前溪，東北有後溪流入焉，下流入德清餘不溪。

translations.literal: South has Front Stream, northeast has Rear Stream flows into it, lower flow enters Deqing Yubu Stream.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Front Stream; the Rear Stream flows in from the northeast, and below they enter the Yubu Stream of Deqing.

sentences.zh: 安吉州元安吉縣。

translations.idiomatic: Anji Zhou was Anji County under the Yuan.

translations.literal: Zhengde first year eleventh month promoted to zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Zhengde 1 it was promoted to a zhou.

sentences.zh: 西南有故城。

translations.literal: Southwest has old city.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the old city.

sentences.zh: 洪武徙於今治。

translations.literal: Hongwu moved to present seat.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu the seat was moved to the present site.

sentences.zh: 東南有白陽山，舊產錫。

translations.literal: Southeast has Baiyang Mountain, formerly produced tin.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Mount Baiyang, which formerly produced tin.

sentences.zh: 西有苕溪。

translations.literal: West has Tiao River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Tiao River.

sentences.zh: 又有龍溪，即苕溪支流。

translations.literal: Also has Long Stream, that is Tiao River branch.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Long Stream, a branch of the Tiao River.

sentences.zh: 東南有獨鬆關巡檢司，又有遞鋪巡檢司，廢。

translations.idiomatic: It lay twenty li northeast of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: Governing counties one:
translations.idiomatic: It governed one county:

sentences.zh: 正德二年改屬州。

translations.literal: Zhengde second year changed subordinate to zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 2 it was placed under the zhou.

sentences.zh: 南有天目山，有天目山巡檢司。

translations.literal: South has Tianmu Mountain, has Tianmu Mountain patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Mount Tianmu, with a Tianmu Mountain patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又西南爲金石山，即天目最高處。

translations.literal: Also southwest is Jinshi Mountain, that is Tianmu highest place.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest is Mount Jinshi, the highest point of Mount Tianmu.

sentences.zh: 又南有苕溪，出天目山，此爲苕溪之別源。

translations.literal: Also south has Tiao River, issues from Tianmu Mountain, this is Tiao River separate source.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is the Tiao River, rising on Mount Tianmu—a separate source of the Tiao.

translations.idiomatic: Farther west is the Songkeng patrol inspectorate.

translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing Prefecture was Shaoxing Route under the Yuan, subordinate to the Zhedong Circuit Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 太祖丙午年十二月爲府。

translations.literal: Taizu bing-wu year twelfth month became prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Taizu's bing-wu year it was made a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領縣八。

translations.literal: Governing counties eight.
translations.idiomatic: It governed eight counties.

sentences.zh: 西北距布政司百三十八里。

translations.literal: Northwest distance from Provincial Administration Commission one hundred thirty-eight li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred thirty-eight li northwest of the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 山陰倚。

translations.literal: Shanyin, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Shanyin was the attached seat county.

sentences.zh: 南有會稽山，其支山爲雲門山，又有法華山。

translations.literal: South has Kuaiji Mountain, its branch mountains are Yunmen Mountain, also has Fahua Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Mount Kuaiji; its offshoots include Mount Yunmen, and there is also Mount Fahua.

sentences.zh: 西南爲蘭亭山。

translations.literal: Southwest is Lanting Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Mount Lanting.

sentences.zh: 西北有塗山。

translations.literal: Northwest has Tu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Mount Tu.

sentences.zh: 北濱海，有三江口。

translations.literal: North borders sea, has Sanjiang mouth.
translations.idiomatic: On the north it faces the sea, at Sanjiang Mouth.

sentences.zh: 三江者，一曰浙江；

translations.literal: Sanjiang ones, one called Zhe River;
translations.idiomatic: The three rivers are, first, the Zhe River;

sentences.zh: 一曰錢清江，即浦陽江下流，其上源自浦江縣流入，至縣西錢清鎮，曰錢清江；

translations.literal: one called Qianqing River, that is Puyang River lower flow, its upper source from Pujiang county flows in, to county west Qianqing town, called Qianqing River;
translations.idiomatic: second, the Qianqing River—the lower course of the Puyang River—whose upper stream enters from Pujiang County and, at Qianqing town west of the county, is called the Qianqing River;

sentences.zh: 一曰曹娥江，即剡溪下流，其上源自嵊縣流入，東折而北，經府東曹娥廟，爲曹娥江，又西折而北，會錢清江、浙江而入海。

translations.literal: one called Cao'e River, that is Shan Stream lower flow, its upper source from Sheng county flows in, east bends and north, passes prefecture east Cao'e Temple, becomes Cao'e River, again west bends and north, meets Qianqing River, Zhe River and enters sea.
translations.idiomatic: third, the Cao'e River—the lower course of the Shan Stream—whose upper stream enters from Sheng County, bends east and north past the Cao'e Temple east of the prefecture, becomes the Cao'e River, then bends west and north to join the Qianqing and Zhe rivers and enter the sea.

sentences.zh: 又西有運河，自蕭山縣流入，又東南逕會稽縣，又東入上虞縣界。

translations.literal: Also west has Grand Canal, from Xiaoshan county flows in, again southeast passes Kuaiji county, again east enters Shangyu county border.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is the Grand Canal, which enters from Xiaoshan County, runs southeast through Kuaiji County, and then east into Shangyu County.

sentences.zh: 又南有鑑湖，長十四五里，俗曰白塔洋，有若耶溪合焉。

translations.literal: Also south has Mirror Lake, length fourteen five li, popularly called Baita Yang, has Ruoye Stream joins it.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is Mirror Lake, fourteen or fifteen li long, popularly called Baita Yang, into which the Ruoye Stream flows.

sentences.zh: 又北有白水湖，旁通運河。

translations.literal: Also north has Baishui Lake, beside connects Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: Farther north is Baishui Lake, connected to the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 北有三江守禦千戶所，在浮山之陽，洪武二十年二月置。

translations.literal: North has Sanjiang garrison-defense thousand-household post, at Fushan south face, Hongwu twentieth year second month established.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Sanjiang garrison-defense thousand-household post, on the south slope of Mount Fu, established in the second month of Hongwu 20.

sentences.zh: 又有三江巡檢司，在浮山桃鬆莊。

translations.literal: Also has Sanjiang patrol inspectorate, at Fushan Taosong village.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Sanjiang patrol inspectorate at Taosong village on Mount Fu.

sentences.zh: 又西北有白洋巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also northwest has Baiyang patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northwest is the Baiyang patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 會稽倚。

translations.literal: Kuaiji, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Kuaiji was the attached seat county.

sentences.zh: 東南爲會稽山，其東接宛委、秦望、天柱諸山。

translations.literal: Southeast is Kuaiji Mountain, its east connects Wanyi, Qinwang, Tianzhu various mountains.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Mount Kuaiji, whose eastern flank joins Mount Wanyi, Mount Qinwang, Mount Tianzhu, and other peaks.

sentences.zh: 又東有銀山、錫山，舊產銀砂及錫。

translations.literal: Also east has Yin Mountain, Xi Mountain, formerly produced silver sand and tin.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east are Mount Yin and Mount Xi, which formerly produced silver sand and tin.

sentences.zh: 東南有若耶山。

translations.literal: Southeast has Ruoye Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Mount Ruoye.

sentences.zh: 東有曹娥江。

translations.literal: East has Cao'e River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Cao'e River.

sentences.zh: 東南有平水溪，南合剡溪。

translations.literal: Southeast has Pingshui Stream, south joins Shan Stream.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Pingshui Stream, which joins the Shan Stream from the south.

sentences.zh: 東北有瀝海守禦千戶所，洪武二十年二月置。

translations.literal: Northeast has Lihai garrison-defense thousand-household post, Hongwu twentieth year second month established.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Lihai garrison-defense thousand-household post, established in the second month of Hongwu 20.

sentences.zh: 又有黃家堰巡檢司，尋遷瀝海所西，後遷上虞縣界纂風鎮，仍故名。

translations.literal: Also has Huangjiayan patrol inspectorate, soon moved Lihai post west, later moved Shangyu county border Zuanfeng town, still old name.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the Huangjiayan patrol inspectorate, soon moved west of the Lihai post and later to Zuanfeng town on the Shangyu County border, retaining its former name.

sentences.zh: 蕭山府西北。

translations.literal: Xiaoshan, northwest of prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoshan lay to the northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 西南有虎爪山，東南有龕山，俱下臨浙江。

translations.literal: Southwest has Huzhua Mountain, southeast has Kan Mountain, both below face Zhe River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Mount Huzhua and to the southeast Mount Kan; both overlook the Zhe River.

sentences.zh: 龕山傍有小山曰鱉子山，浙江自縣西東北流，出其中，東接大海，亦曰海門。

translations.literal: Kan Mountain beside has small mountain called Biezi Mountain, Zhe River from county west northeast flows, exits among them, east connects great sea, also called Sea Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Beside Mount Kan is a lesser hill called Mount Biezi; the Zhe River flows northeast from west of the county between them to the open sea, also called the Sea Gate.

sentences.zh: 東南有峽山，錢清江經其中，復北折而東，入山陰縣界。

translations.literal: Southeast has Xia Mountain, Qianqing River passes among them, again north bends and east, enters Shanyin county border.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Mount Xia, through which the Qianqing River passes before bending north and east into Shanyin County.

sentences.zh: 城西有運河，東接錢清江。

translations.literal: City west has Grand Canal, east connects Qianqing River.
translations.idiomatic: West of the city is the Grand Canal, which eastward joins the Qianqing River.

sentences.zh: 又有湘湖。

translations.literal: Also has Xiang Lake.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Xiang Lake.

sentences.zh: 西南有漁浦巡檢司。

translations.literal: Southwest has Yupu patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Yupu patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又西有西興，亦曰西陵，往錢塘者由此渡江。

translations.literal: Also west has Xixing, also called Xiling, those going to Qiantang cross river from here.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is Xixing, also called Xiling, where travelers to Qiantang crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 諸暨府西南。

translations.literal: Zhuji, southwest of prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuji lay to the southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 元諸暨州。

translations.literal: Yuan Zhuji zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Zhuji Zhou.

sentences.zh: 大祖己亥年正月改諸全州。

translations.literal: Great Ancestor ji-hai year first month changed to Zhuquan zhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Taizu's ji-hai year it was renamed Zhuquan Zhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午年十二月降爲諸暨縣。

translations.literal: Bing-wu year twelfth month reduced to Zhuji county.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the bing-wu year it was reduced to Zhuji County.

sentences.zh: 西南有新城，在五指山下，太祖癸卯年，李文忠所築。

translations.literal: Southwest has new city, at Wuzhi Mountain below, Taizu gui-mao year, Li Wenzhong built.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is a new city below Mount Wuzhi, built by Li Wenzhong in Taizu's gui-mao year.

sentences.zh: 西有長山，又有五泄山。

translations.literal: West has Chang Mountain, also has Wuxie Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west are Mount Chang and Mount Wuxie.

sentences.zh: 南有句乘山。

translations.literal: South has Goucheng Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Mount Goucheng.

sentences.zh: 又有浣江，即浦陽江，亦曰青弋江。

translations.literal: Also has Huan River, that is Puyang River, also called Qingyi River.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Huan River—the Puyang River, also called the Qingyi River.

sentences.zh: 又西南有長清關、西有陽塘關二巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: Also southwest has Changqing Pass, west has Yangtang Pass two patrol inspectorates, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest were the Changqing Pass and Yangtang Pass patrol inspectorates, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 餘姚府東北。

translations.literal: Yuyao, northeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Yuyao County lay northeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 元餘姚州。

translations.literal: Yuan was Yuyao zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Yuyao zhou.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，降爲縣。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu, reduced to a county.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Hongwu reign it was reduced to a county.

sentences.zh: 南有新城，與縣城隔江對峙，姚江經其中。

translations.literal: South has new city, with county seat faces each other across river, Yao River passes between.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is a new city facing the county seat across the river, with the Yao River running between them.

sentences.zh: 南有四明山，北瀕海。

translations.literal: South has Siming Mountain, north borders sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Siming Mountain; to the north it borders the sea.

sentences.zh: 姚江源自縣西南太平山，一名舜江，西北流至上虞縣，乃東北出，經縣南。

translations.idiomatic: The Yao River rises at Taiping Mountain in the southwest of the county—also called the Shun River—flows northwest to Shangyu County, then turns northeast and passes south of the county.

sentences.zh: 又東爲慈溪之前江。

translations.literal: Also east becomes Cixi's Front River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east it becomes Cixi's Front River.

sentences.zh: 東北有燭溪湖，引流爲東橫河。

translations.literal: Northeast has Zhuxi Lake, diverted to form East Cross River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Zhuxi Lake, whose outflow forms the East Cross River.

sentences.zh: 西有牟山湖，引流爲西橫河，俱注於姚江。

translations.literal: West has Mou Lake, diverted to form West Cross River, both pour into Yao River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Mou Lake, whose outflow forms the West Cross River; both enter the Yao.

sentences.zh: 又西北有臨山衛，洪武二十年二月置。

translations.literal: Also northwest has Linshan Guard, established second month Hongwu twentieth year.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Linshan Guard, established in the second month of Hongwu 20.

sentences.zh: 東北有三山守禦千戶所，一名滸山，亦洪武二十年二月置。

translations.literal: Northeast has Sanshan garrison-defense thousand-household post, one name Hushan, also established second month Hongwu twentieth year.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Sanshan garrison-defense thousand-household post—also called Hushan—likewise established in the second month of Hongwu 20.

sentences.zh: 又東北有三山巡檢司，治金家山上，尋遷破山。

translations.literal: Also northeast has Sanshan patrol inspectorate, governed at Jinjia Mountain, soon moved to Poshan.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northeast is the Sanshan patrol inspectorate, first at Jinjia Mountain and soon moved to Poshan.

translations.literal: North has Meishan patrol inspectorate, governed at Meishan stockade, soon moved to county northwest Huhaitou.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Meishan patrol inspectorate, first at Meishan stockade and soon moved to Huhaitou northwest of the county.

sentences.zh: 又有廟山巡檢司，治廟山寨，尋遷上虞縣界中源堰，仍故名。

translations.literal: Also has Miaoshan patrol inspectorate, governed at Miaoshan stockade, soon moved to Shangyu County border Zhongyuan weir, still old name.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the Miaoshan patrol inspectorate, first at Miaoshan stockade and soon moved to Zhongyuan weir on the Shangyu border, retaining its old name.

sentences.zh: 上虞府東。

translations.literal: Shangyu, east of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Shangyu County lay east of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 西北有夏蓋山，北枕海，南臨夏蓋湖。

translations.literal: Northwest has Xiagai Mountain, north rests on sea, south faces Xiagai Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Xiagai Mountain, with the sea to the north and Xiagai Lake to the south.

sentences.zh: 西南有東山。

translations.literal: Southwest has East Mountain.

sentences.zh: 其北爲前千戶所，洪武二十八年置。

translations.literal: Its north was Front thousand-household post, Hongwu twenty-eighth year established.
translations.idiomatic: To its north was the Front thousand-household post, established in Hongwu 28.

sentences.zh: 東北有桃渚前千戶所，洪武二十年九月置。

translations.literal: Northeast has Taozhu Front thousand-household post, Hongwu twentieth year ninth month established.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Taozhu Front thousand-household post, established in the ninth month of Hongwu 20.

sentences.zh: 東有蛟湖巡檢司，遷治海口陶嶼。

translations.literal: East has Jiaohu patrol inspectorate, moved administration to seaport Tao Islet.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Jiaohu patrol inspectorate, whose seat was moved to Tao Islet at the seaport.

sentences.zh: 又有連盤巡檢司，遷治海口長沙。

translations.literal: Also has Lianpan patrol inspectorate, moved administration to seaport Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Lianpan patrol inspectorate, whose seat was moved to Changsha at the seaport.

sentences.zh: 俱仍故名。

translations.literal: All still original names.
translations.idiomatic: Both retained their original names.

sentences.zh: 黃岩府東南。

translations.literal: Huangyan, prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Huangyan County lies southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 元黃岩州。

translations.literal: Yuan Huangyan zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Huangyan zhou.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年三月降爲縣。

translations.literal: Hongwu third year third month demoted to county.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Hongwu 3 it was reduced to a county.

sentences.zh: 南有委羽山。

translations.literal: South has Weiyu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Weiyu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東有大海。

translations.literal: East has great sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the open sea.

sentences.zh: 西北有永寧江，即澄江下流。

translations.literal: Northwest has Yongning River, namely Cheng River lower course.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Yongning River, the lower course of the Cheng River.

sentences.zh: 東南有鹽場，又有長浦巡檢司。

translations.literal: Southeast has salt works, also has Changpu patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast are salt works and the Changpu patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 天台府西南。

translations.literal: Tiantai, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Tiantai County lies southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 西有天台山。

translations.literal: West has Mount Tiantai.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Mount Tiantai.

sentences.zh: 北有赤城山，又有石橋山，皆天台支阜也，其絕頂曰華頂峯。

translations.literal: North has Chicheng Mountain, also has Shiqiao Mountain, all Mount Tiantai branch foothills, its summit called Huading Peak.
translations.idiomatic: To the north are Chicheng Mountain and Shiqiao Mountain, foothills of Mount Tiantai; their highest point is Huading Peak.

sentences.zh: 又西南有始豐溪，即澄江上源。

translations.literal: Also southwest has Shifeng Stream, namely Cheng River upper source.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest is Shifeng Stream, the upper source of the Cheng River.

sentences.zh: 又東有楢溪，產鐵。

translations.literal: Also east has You Stream, produces iron.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is You Stream, which produced iron.

sentences.zh: 其東爲甬溪。

translations.literal: Its east is Yong Stream.
translations.idiomatic: East of it is Yong Stream.

sentences.zh: 又西有胡竇巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: Also west has Hudou patrol inspectorate, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the west was the Hudou patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 仙居府西南。

translations.literal: Xianju, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Xianju County lies southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 西北有蒼嶺，即括蒼山。

translations.literal: Northwest has Cang Ridge, namely Kuocang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Cang Ridge—that is, Kuocang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 又有永安溪，下流亦會於澄江。

translations.literal: Also has Yong'an Stream, lower course also joins at Cheng River.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Yong'an Stream, whose lower course likewise joins the Cheng River.

sentences.zh: 又西南有曹溪，東有彭溪，俱流合於永安溪。

translations.literal: Also southwest has Cao Stream, east has Peng Stream, all flow join at Yong'an Stream.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest is Cao Stream; to the east is Peng Stream; both flow into Yong'an Stream.

sentences.zh: 西有田寺巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: West has Tiansi patrol inspectorate, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the west was the Tiansi patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 寧海府東北。

translations.literal: Ninghai, prefecture northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Ninghai County lies northeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 北有天門山。

translations.literal: North has Tianmen Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Tianmen Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西北有龍鬚山，舊產銅鐵。

translations.literal: Northwest has Longxu Mountain, formerly produced copper and iron.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Longxu Mountain, which formerly produced copper and iron.

sentences.zh: 東濱海。

translations.literal: East borders sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the east it borders the sea.

sentences.zh: 東北有鄞江，與象山縣界。

translations.literal: Northeast has Yin River, borders with Xiangshan County.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Yin River, which forms the boundary with Xiangshan County.

sentences.zh: 南有海遊溪，有寧和溪，又有東溪，東有鐵砂，冶之成鐵，俱導流入海。

translations.literal: South has Haiyou Stream, has Ninghe Stream, also has East Stream, east has iron sand, smelted into iron, all guided flow enter sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the south are Haiyou Stream, Ninghe Stream, and East Stream; iron sand to the east was smelted into iron; all are channeled to the sea.

sentences.zh: 又有梅嶴鎮，舊有鐵場。

translations.literal: Also has Meiyu Town, formerly had iron works.
translations.idiomatic: There is also Meiyu Town, which formerly had iron works.

sentences.zh: 又南有健跳千戶所，洪武二十年九月置。

translations.literal: Also south has Jiantiao thousand-household post, Hongwu twentieth year ninth month established.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is the Jiantiao thousand-household post, established in the ninth month of Hongwu 20.

sentences.zh: 東有越溪、又有長亭、北有鐵場、南有曼嶴、東南有竇嶴五巡檢司。

translations.literal: East has Yue Stream, also has Changting, north has Iron Works, south has Manyu, southeast has Douyu five patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the east are the Yue Stream, Changting, Iron Works to the north, Manyu to the south, and Douyu to the southeast—five patrol inspectorates in all.

sentences.zh: 太平府東南。

translations.literal: Taiping, prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping County lies southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 成化五年十二月以黃岩縣之太平鄉置，析樂清地益之。

translations.literal: Chenghua fifth year twelfth month using Huangyan County's Taiping township established, split Yueqing territory to augment it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Chenghua 5 it was established from Taiping township in Huangyan County, with territory taken from Yueqing to enlarge it.

sentences.zh: 南有大雷山。

translations.literal: South has Great Thunder Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Great Thunder Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西北有王城山。

translations.literal: Northwest has Wangcheng Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Wangcheng Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西南有靈山，與玉環山接。

translations.literal: Southwest has Lingshan, connects with Yuhuan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is Lingshan, which joins Yuhuan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 東南濱海，曰大閭洋，中有鬆門、石塘、大陳等山。

translations.literal: Southeast borders sea, called Dalü Sea, within has Songmen, Shitang, Dachen and other mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The southeast faces the sea at what is called Dalü Sea, with Songmen, Shitang, Dachen, and other mountains within it.

sentences.zh: 又東有遷江，一名新建河，至縣北曰官塘河，北抵黃岩縣，東入海。

translations.literal: Also east has Qian River, one name Newly Built River, to county north called Guantang River, north reaches Huangyan County, east enters sea.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is the Qian River, also called the Newly Built River; north of the county it is called the Guantang River, which reaches Huangyan County to the north and enters the sea to the east.

sentences.zh: 東有鬆門衛，本鬆門千戶所，洪武十九年十二月置，二十年六月升爲衛。

translations.literal: East has Songmen Guard, originally Songmen thousand-household post, Hongwu nineteenth year twelfth month established, twentieth year sixth month promoted to guard.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Songmen Guard, originally the Songmen thousand-household post established in the twelfth month of Hongwu 19 and promoted to a guard in the sixth month of Hongwu 20.

sentences.zh: 東北有新河千戶所，洪武十九年十二月置。

translations.literal: Northeast has Xinhe thousand-household post, Hongwu nineteenth year twelfth month established.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Xinhe thousand-household post, established in the twelfth month of Hongwu 19.

sentences.zh: 南有隘頑千戶所，西南有楚門千戶所，俱洪武二十年二月置。

translations.literal: South has Aiyan thousand-household post, southwest has Chumen thousand-household post, all Hongwu twentieth year second month established.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Aiyan thousand-household post and to the southwest the Chumen thousand-household post, both established in the second month of Hongwu 20.

sentences.zh: 又東有盤馬、西有二山、又有蒲岐三巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also east has Panma, west has Ershan, also has Puqi three patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east are the Panma, Ershan, and Puqi patrol inspectorates.

sentences.zh: 南有沙角巡檢司，本治岐頭山下，後遷今治。

translations.literal: South has Shajiao patrol inspectorate, originally administered below Qitou Mountain, later moved to present administration.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Shajiao patrol inspectorate, first below Qitou Mountain and later moved to its present seat.

sentences.zh: 西南有小鹿巡檢司，遷治楚門所之橫山後。

translations.literal: Southwest has Xiaolu patrol inspectorate, moved administration to Chumen post's Hengshan rear.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Xiaolu patrol inspectorate, whose seat was moved to the rear of Hengshan at Chumen post.

sentences.zh: 西有溫嶺巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: West has Wenling patrol inspectorate, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the west was the Wenling patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 金華府元婺州路，屬浙東宣慰司。

translations.literal: Jinhua Prefecture Yuan Wuzhou Route, belonged to Zhedong Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Jinhua Prefecture was the Yuan Wuzhou Route, subordinate to the Zhedong Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 太祖戊戌年十二月爲甯越府。

translations.literal: Taizu wuxu year twelfth month became Ningyue Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the Taizu wuxu year it became Ningyue Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚子年正月曰金華府。

translations.literal: Gengzi year first month called Jinhua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the gengzi year it was named Jinhua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領縣八。

translations.literal: Administered counties eight.
translations.idiomatic: It administered eight counties.

sentences.zh: 東北距布政司四百五十里。

translations.literal: Northeast distance from Provincial Administration Commission four hundred fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay four hundred fifty li northeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 金華倚。

translations.literal: Jinhua, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Jinhua was the attached seat county.

sentences.zh: 北有金華山。

translations.literal: North has Jinhua Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Jinhua Mountain.

sentences.zh: 南有銅山，舊產銅。

translations.literal: South has Tong Mountain, formerly produced copper.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Tong Mountain, which formerly produced copper.

sentences.zh: 城南有東陽江，亦曰婺港，自東陽縣流經此。

translations.literal: South of city has Dongyang River, also called Wu Harbor, from Dongyang County flows passing here.
translations.idiomatic: South of the city is the Dongyang River, also called Wu Harbor, which flows here from Dongyang County.

sentences.zh: 又有南溪，自縉雲縣來合焉，謂之雙溪，亦曰縠溪，合流至蘭溪而會於信安江。

translations.literal: Also has South Stream, from Jinyun County comes to join there, called Twin Streams, also called Hu Stream, combined flow to Lanxi then joins at Xin'an River.
translations.idiomatic: The South Stream also comes from Jinyun County to join it, forming what is called the Twin Streams or Hu Stream, which flows to Lanxi and then meets the Xin'an River.

sentences.zh: 蘭谿府西。

translations.literal: Lanxi, prefecture west.
translations.idiomatic: Lanxi County lies west of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 元蘭谿州。

translations.literal: Yuan Lanxi zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was Lanxi zhou.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年三月降爲縣。

translations.literal: Hongwu third year third month demoted to county.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Hongwu 3 it was reduced to a county.

sentences.zh: 東有銅山，舊產銅。

translations.literal: East has Tong Mountain, formerly produced copper.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Tong Mountain, which formerly produced copper.

sentences.zh: 西南有蘭溪，即彀溪也，亦曰大溪，一自衢州之衢港，一自金華之婺港，會於西南蘭陰山下，北入嚴州界。

translations.literal: Southwest has Lan Stream, namely Hu Stream, also called Great Stream, one from Quzhou's Qu Harbor, one from Jinhua's Wu Harbor, meet at southwest Lanyin Mountain foot, north enters Yanzhou border.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Lan Stream—that is, the Hu Stream, also called the Great Stream—with one branch from Qu Harbor in Quzhou and one from Wu Harbor in Jinhua; they meet below Lanyin Mountain to the southwest and flow north into Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 西北有平渡巡檢司。

translations.literal: Northwest has Pingdu patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Pingdu patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 北有靈泉鄉、龍巖鄉二巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: North has Lingspring Township, Longyan Township two patrol inspectorates, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the north were the Lingspring Township and Longyan Township patrol inspectorates, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 東陽府東。

translations.literal: Dongyang, prefecture east.
translations.idiomatic: Dongyang County lies east of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 東南有大盆山，東陽江出焉，經縣北，謂之北溪，亦曰東溪，西南有畫溪，下流至義烏縣入焉。

translations.literal: Southeast has Dapen Mountain, Dongyang River issues there, passes county north, called North Stream, also called East Stream, southwest has Hua Stream, lower course to Yiwu County enters there.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Dapen Mountain, where the Dongyang River rises; passing north of the county it is called the North Stream or East Stream; Hua Stream to the southwest flows down into it at Yiwu County.

sentences.zh: 東有永寧巡檢司。

translations.literal: East has Yongning patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Yongning patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又東南有瑞山、玉山。

translations.literal: Also southeast has Ruishan, Yushan.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast are Ruishan and Yushan.

sentences.zh: 南有興賢、仁壽二巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: South has Xingxian, Renshou two patrol inspectorates, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the south were the Xingxian and Renshou patrol inspectorates, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 義烏府東少北。

translations.literal: Yiwu, prefecture east slightly north.
translations.idiomatic: Yiwu County lies east and slightly north of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 南有烏傷溪，即東陽江。

translations.literal: South has Wushang Stream, namely Dongyang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Wushang Stream—that is, the Dongyang River.

sentences.zh: 西有智者同義鄉、南有雙林明義鄉、北有龍祈鎮三巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: West has Zhizhe Tongyi Township, south has Shuanglin Mingyi Township, north has Longqi Town three patrol inspectorates, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the west were the Zhizhe Tongyi Township, Shuanglin Mingyi Township to the south, and Longqi Town to the north patrol inspectorates—all later abolished.

sentences.zh: 永康府東南。

translations.literal: Yongkang, prefecture southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Yongkang County lies southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 東南有銅山，舊產銅。

translations.literal: Southeast has Tong Mountain, formerly produced copper.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is Tong Mountain, which formerly produced copper.

sentences.zh: 南有南溪，亦曰永康溪。

translations.literal: South has South Stream, also called Yongkang Stream.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the South Stream, also called the Yongkang Stream.

sentences.zh: 又東有孝義寨、南有義豐鄉、東南有合德鄉三巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: Also east has Xiaoyi Stockade, south has Yifeng Township, southeast has Hede Township three patrol inspectorates, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east was the Xiaoyi Stockade patrol inspectorate, to the south Yifeng Township, and to the southeast Hede Township—all later abolished.

sentences.zh: 武義府南少東。

translations.literal: Wuyi, prefecture south slightly east.
translations.idiomatic: Wuyi County lies south and slightly east of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 東北有永康溪，又有茭道市。

translations.literal: Northeast has Yongkang Stream, also has Jiaodao Market.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is Yongkang Stream and also Jiaodao Market.

sentences.zh: 西有苦竹市。

translations.literal: West has Kuzhu Market.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Kuzhu Market.

sentences.zh: 又北有白溪口市。

translations.literal: Also north has Baixikou Market.
translations.idiomatic: Farther north is Baixikou Market.

sentences.zh: 蒲江府東北。

translations.literal: Pujiang, prefecture northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Pujiang County lies northeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 西有深嫋山，蒲陽江出焉，東流入諸暨縣界。

translations.literal: West has Shen'ao Mountain, Puyang River issues there, east flows into Zhuji County border.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Shen'ao Mountain, where the Puyang River rises and flows east into Zhuji County.

sentences.zh: 東有楊家埠巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: East has Yangjiabu patrol inspectorate, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the east was the Yangjiabu patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 湯溪府西南。

translations.literal: Tangxi, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Tangxi County lies southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 成化七年正月析蘭溪、金華、龍遊、遂昌四縣地置。

translations.literal: Chenghua seventh year first month split Lanxi, Jinhua, Longyou, Suichang four counties' territory established.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Chenghua 7 it was established from territory taken from Lanxi, Jinhua, Longyou, and Suichang counties.

sentences.zh: 南有銀嶺。

translations.literal: South has Yin Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Yin Ridge.

sentences.zh: 西北有縠江，即信安江。

translations.literal: Northwest has Hu River, namely Xin'an River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Hu River—that is, the Xin'an River.

sentences.zh: 衢州府元衢州路，屬浙東道宣慰司。

translations.literal: Quzhou Prefecture Yuan Quzhou Route, belonged to Zhedong Circuit Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Quzhou Prefecture was the Yuan Quzhou Route, subordinate to the Zhedong Circuit Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 太祖己亥年九月爲龍遊府。

translations.literal: Taizu Jihai year ninth month became Longyou Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Jihai, the first year of the Taizu reign, it became Longyou Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙午年爲衢州府。

translations.literal: Bingwu year became Quzhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Bingwu year it became Quzhou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領縣五。

translations.literal: Administered counties five.
translations.idiomatic: It administered five counties.

sentences.zh: 東北距布政司五百六十里。

translations.literal: Northeast distance from Provincial Administration Commission five hundred sixty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay five hundred sixty li northeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 西安倚。

translations.literal: Xi'an, attached.
translations.idiomatic: Xi'an was the attached seat county.

sentences.zh: 永樂二十二年建越王府，宣德二年除。

translations.literal: Yongle twenty-second year built Yue princely mansion, Xuande second year abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 22 the princely mansion of Yue was built; in Xuande 2 it was abolished.

sentences.zh: 西有巖山。

translations.literal: West has Yanshan.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Yanshan.

sentences.zh: 南有爛柯山，又有爵豆山，舊出銀。

translations.literal: South has Lankeshan, also has Juedoushan, formerly produced silver.
translations.idiomatic: To the south are Lankeshan and Juedoushan, which once produced silver.

sentences.zh: 又西北有銅山，舊出銅、錫、鉛。

translations.literal: Also northwest has Tongshan, formerly produced copper, tin, lead.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northwest is Tongshan, which once produced copper, tin, and lead.

sentences.zh: 城西南有衢江，其上源曰大溪，自江山縣流入。

translations.literal: City southwest has Qu River, its upper reach called Great Stream, from Jiangshan County enters.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of the city is the Qu River, whose upper reach is called the Great Stream, entering from Jiangshan County.

sentences.zh: 又有西溪，亦曰信安溪，自開化縣發源，流至此與大溪合焉，曰雙港口。

translations.literal: Also has West Stream, also called Xin'an Stream, from Kaihua County issues source, flows to here and Great Stream unite, called Shuanggangkou.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the West Stream, also called the Xin'an Stream, which rises in Kaihua County and joins the Great Stream here at Shuanggangkou.

sentences.zh: 又東有定陽溪，一名東溪，自遂昌縣流入，合於衢江。

translations.literal: Also east has Dingyang Stream, one name East Stream, from Suichang County enters, joins at Qu River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is the Dingyang Stream, also called the East Stream, entering from Suichang County and joining the Qu River.

sentences.zh: 西南有嚴剝、東南有板固二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Southwest has Yanbo, southeast has Bagu two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Yanbo patrol inspectorate; to the southeast is the Bagu patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 龍遊府東。

translations.literal: Longyou, prefecture east.
translations.idiomatic: Longyou County lies east of the prefectural seat.

translations.idiomatic: It administered five counties.

translations.idiomatic: To the south is Daluo Mountain.

translations.idiomatic: It borders the sea to the east.

translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2 it was reduced to a county.

translations.literal: East has North Yandang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is North Yandang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 南濱海，有玉環山，在海中。

translations.literal: South borders sea, has Yuhuan Mountain, in sea within.
translations.idiomatic: It borders the sea to the south, with Mount Yuhuan in the sea.

sentences.zh: 又西北有荊溪。

translations.literal: Also northwest has Jing Stream.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northwest is Jing Stream.

sentences.zh: 又縣治傍有東、西二溪。

translations.literal: Also county seat beside has east, west two streams.
translations.idiomatic: Beside the county seat are the Eastern and Western streams.

sentences.zh: 西南有館頭江。

translations.literal: Southwest has Guantou River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Guantou River.

sentences.zh: 西有象浦河，東北有石馬港，下流皆達海。

translations.literal: West has Xiangpu River, northeast has Shima Harbor, lower flows all reach sea.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Xiangpu River and to the northeast Shima Harbor; their lower courses all reach the sea.

sentences.zh: 有長林鹽場。

translations.literal: Has Changlin salt field.
translations.idiomatic: There is the Changlin salt field.

sentences.zh: 又西有盤石衛，洪武二十年二月置。

translations.literal: Also west has Panshi Guard, Hongwu twentieth year second month established.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is Panshi Guard, established in the second month of Hongwu 20.

sentences.zh: 東有盤石守禦後千戶所，成化五年置。

translations.literal: East has Panshi garrison-defense Rear thousand-household post, Chenghua fifth year established.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Panshi garrison-defense Rear thousand-household post, established in Chenghua 5.

sentences.zh: 東北有蒲岐守禦千戶所，亦洪武二十年二月置。

translations.literal: Northeast has Puqi garrison-defense thousand-household post, also Hongwu twentieth year second month established.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast is the Puqi garrison-defense thousand-household post, also established in the second month of Hongwu 20.

sentences.zh: 西有館頭巡檢司，遷治縣西南岐頭寨。

translations.literal: West has Guantou patrol inspectorate, moved governance to county southwest Qitou Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Guantou patrol inspectorate, whose seat was moved to Qitou Stockade southwest of the county.

sentences.zh: 後復。

translations.literal: Later restored.
translations.idiomatic: It was later restored.

sentences.zh: 東南有北監巡檢司，治玉環山下，尋遷縣東北蔡嶴，又遷縣東白沙嶺，又遷鶚頭，又遷窯嶴山下，仍故名。

translations.literal: Southeast has Beijian patrol inspectorate, governed below Yuhuan Mountain, soon moved to county northeast Cai'ao, again moved to county east Baisha Ridge, again moved to Etou, again moved to below Yaoxiao Mountain, still original name.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Beijian patrol inspectorate, first below Mount Yuhuan, then moved to Cai'ao northeast of the county, then to Baisha Ridge east of the county, then to Etou, then below Yaoxiao Mountain, retaining its former name.

sentences.zh: 平陽府西南。

translations.literal: Pingyang, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Pingyang County lies southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 元平陽州。

translations.literal: Yuan Pingyang zhou.
translations.idiomatic: It was Pingyang zhou under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年降爲縣。

translations.literal: Hongwu third year reduced to county.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 3 it was reduced to a county.

sentences.zh: 西南有南雁蕩山，有玉蒼山。

translations.literal: Southwest has South Yandang Mountain, has Yucang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest are South Yandang Mountain and Mount Yucang.

sentences.zh: 又東南海中有大巖頭山，有南麂山。

translations.literal: Also southeast sea within has Dayantou Mountain, has Nanji Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast in the sea are Dayantou Mountain and Nanji Mountain.

sentences.zh: 又西有前倉江，亦曰橫陽江，東南經江口關注於海。

translations.literal: Also west has Qiancang River, also called Hengyang River, southeast passes Jiangkou Pass pours into sea.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is the Qiancang River—also called the Hengyang River—which passes southeast through Jiangkou Pass into the sea.

sentences.zh: 南有天富南鹽場。

translations.literal: South has Tianfu South salt field.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Tianfu South salt field.

sentences.zh: 又南有金鄉衛，有蒲門守禦千戶所，東北有壯士守禦千戶所，皆洪武二十年二月置。

translations.literal: Also south has Jinxiang Guard, has Pumen garrison-defense thousand-household post, northeast has Zhuangshi garrison-defense thousand-household post, all Hongwu twentieth year second month established.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is Jinxiang Guard, with the Pumen garrison-defense thousand-household post and the Zhuangshi post to the northeast—all established in the second month of Hongwu 20.

sentences.zh: 東南有舥艚、又有斗門二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Southeast has Bochao, also has Doumen two patrol inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast are the Bochao and Doumen patrol inspectorates.

sentences.zh: 南有江口巡檢司，治下埠，後遷渡頭。

translations.literal: South has Jiangkou patrol inspectorate, governed Xiabu, later moved Dutou.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Jiangkou patrol inspectorate, first at Xiabu and later moved to Dutou.

sentences.zh: 又東有仙口巡檢司，遷縣南麥城山，仍故名。

translations.literal: Also east has Xiankou patrol inspectorate, moved to county south Maicheng Mountain, still original name.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is the Xiankou patrol inspectorate, moved to Maicheng Mountain south of the county but retaining its former name.

sentences.zh: 又東南有龜峯巡檢司，廢。

translations.literal: Also southeast has Guifeng patrol inspectorate, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast was the Guifeng patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 泰順府西南。

translations.literal: Taishun, prefecture southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Taishun lies southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年以瑞安縣羅洋鎮置，析平陽縣地益之。

translations.literal: Jingtai third year from Ruian County Luoyang Town established, split Pingyang County territory added.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai 3 it was established from Luoyang Town in Ruian County, with territory taken from Pingyang County.

sentences.zh: 南有分水山，上有關，爲浙、閩分界處。

translations.literal: South has Fenghui Mountain, atop has pass, is Zhe, Min boundary place.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Fenghui Mountain with a pass atop it marking the border between Zhejiang and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 又西有白溪，下流至福建寧德縣入海。

translations.literal: Also west has Bai Stream, lower flow to Fujian Ningde County enters sea.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is Bai Stream, whose lower course reaches the sea at Ningde County in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 又東有仙居溪，流入瑞安境入海。

translations.literal: Also east has Xianju Stream, flows entering Ruian territory enters sea.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is Xianju Stream, which flows into Ruian territory and reaches the sea.

sentences.zh: 北有池村巡檢司。

translations.literal: North has Chichun patrol inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the Chichun patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 南有三冠巡檢司，本洋望，後更名。

translations.literal: South has Sanguan patrol inspectorate, originally Yangwang, later renamed.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is the Sanguan patrol inspectorate, originally called Yangwang and later renamed.

sentences.zh: 東南有鴉陽巡檢司，後廢。

translations.literal: Southeast has Yayang patrol inspectorate, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast was the Yayang patrol inspectorate, later abolished.

sentences.zh: 又羅陽第一關在縣東。

translations.literal: Also Luoyang First Pass at county east.
translations.idiomatic: The Luoyang First Pass lies east of the county.
